AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CineMME 基准，用于诊断多模态视频模型在叙事视频理解中“从对话提取证据、绑定说话人并推断情节含义”的能力。它包含人工验证的短叙事视频、对话时间定位/转录/主动说话人定位任务，以及涵盖感知、音频、叙事、社交和镜头呈现理解的多选与开放式问答，并评估了多种 MLLM 与 omni-modal 模型，揭示了明显的“谁-什么-何时”解耦问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视频理解基准虽然涵盖视频问答、音视频推理和时间定位等任务，但很少在相同片段内检验模型能否形成连贯的“对话—说话人—情节证据链”。叙事视频理解不仅要求识别可见事件，还要求模型从对话中抽取证据、将语音正确绑定到说话人，并据此推断叙事意义。因此，需要一个专门诊断对话驱动情节理解能力的多模态视频基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了 CineMME 基准，包含约 1,600 专家人时标注和 975 个短叙事视频片段，并设计两个关联任务轨道：一是 CineMME-Grounding，提供 13,554 个带时间戳的语音片段和 33,083 个说话人脸框，用于时间对话定位、语音转录和主动说话人定位；二是 CineMME-Reasoning，包含 1,600 道多选题和 316 道开放式问题，覆盖感知、音频、叙事、社交和镜头呈现等理解维度。论文进一步比较 20 个 MLLM 在推理任务上的表现和 9 个 omni-modal 模型在定位任务上的表现，并通过模态消融分析视觉信息对不同问题的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果显示模型存在显著的“谁-什么-何时”解耦：以 Gemini-3 Pro 为例，它在对话时间定位上达到 68.34% 的 tIoU，转录词错误率为 28.99%，但在主动说话人定位上仅有 7.74% 的 vIoU；同时在具有可提取答案的问题上，其多选准确率为 67.66%。模态消融表明视觉信息并非总是有益：它能提升偏重视觉感知的问题表现，但可能削弱以对话为中心的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: CineMME 提供了一个紧凑且具有诊断性的测试平台，用于评估多模态视频模型是否真正能够将对话、说话人、视觉证据和叙事意义连接起来。该基准揭示了当前模型在主动说话人绑定和对话驱动情节推理上的关键短板，强调未来多模态视频理解研究需要更强地将“听到了什么、谁说的、何时发生”与情节含义进行统一建模。

title: Bridging Update Coordination and Flatness in Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning combines complementary knowledge across clients to alleviate local data limitations without sharing raw samples. However, data heterogeneity can cause conflicting updates and hinder generalization. Update coordination reduces interference among client updates, while flatness optimization reduces sensitivity to parameter perturbations to improve generalization. Existing joint designs largely target specific algorithms, limiting flexible combinations of these approaches. To address this problem, we propose a unified federated learning framework that bridges update coordination and flatness optimization. Clients separately accumulate descent signals and flatness corrections along the same local trajectory. The server coordinates both groups with independent states before fusing their outputs into a global update. Explicit conversion between trajectory signals and model updates enables different coordination strategies to work with compatible local or globally guided flatness mechanisms without changing the inference architecture. Experiments show that the evaluated combinations generally improve average and worst-client accuracy over update coordination alone, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework in combining these complementary optimization mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个统一的联邦学习框架，将“更新协调”与“平坦度优化”解耦并结合：客户端沿同一局部轨迹分别累积下降信号和平坦度修正，服务器独立维护两组状态后再融合生成全局更新，从而提升异质数据下的平均精度和最差客户端精度。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可通过跨客户端协同利用互补知识缓解本地数据不足，但数据异质性会导致各客户端模型更新相互冲突，损害泛化。已有方法分别通过更新协调降低客户端更新干扰，或通过平坦度优化降低模型对参数扰动的敏感性；然而现有联合设计多针对特定算法，难以灵活组合不同协调策略与平坦度机制。
AI.method: 论文提出统一联邦学习框架，使客户端在同一条局部轨迹上分别累积两类信号：用于降低局部损失的下降信号，以及用于改善损失景观平坦度的修正信号。服务器对下降信号和平坦度修正分别进行协调并维护独立状态，随后将二者融合形成全局模型更新。通过显式转换轨迹信号与模型更新，该框架允许不同协调策略与兼容的局部平坦度机制或全局引导平坦度机制组合，而不改变推理架构。
AI.result: 实验表明，在多种被评估的组合中，所提框架相较于仅使用更新协调的方法，总体能够提高平均客户端精度和最差客户端精度，说明将更新协调与平坦度优化结合具有有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过解耦局部轨迹上的下降信号与平坦度修正，并在服务器端独立协调与融合，实现了更新协调和平坦度优化的灵活组合。它有助于缓解联邦学习中由数据异质性引起的更新冲突和泛化不足问题，为统一设计联邦优化机制提供了可扩展路径。

title: MAST: Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering for Visual Grounding in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Existing activation steering methods for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) use the global activation mean as the steering vector, which tends to cause cross-task interference and unstable performance. We trace this failure to the multi-centered geometry of task activations. The global mean lands in the empty region between clusters and is faithful to no single task. Moreover, the steering signal in each task-pure local cluster is low-rank, and different query tasks benefit from emphasizing different families of local-basis directions under the shared routing protocol. To address this, we propose MAST (Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering), a training-free, input-adaptive activation steering framework. MAST groups samples by task, performs multi-center clustering within each group, and selects one representative medoid per cluster. At inference time, each query is routed to multiple representative medoids. For each matched cluster, a low-rank local steering direction is extracted and aggregated across clusters to produce the final steering vector. Building on MAST, MAST-PR (Probe-Reweighted) uses a lightweight task-aware probe to reweight task-specialized local-direction families, yielding a further average improvement of +8.09 points over MAST.

AI.tldr: 该摘要提出 MAST（Medoid-Anchored Subspace Steering）和 MAST-PR：一种训练无关、输入自适应的多模态大模型激活 steered 方法，核心是用多中心 medoid 和局部低秩子空间聚合替代传统全局均值 steering vector，并通过任务感知 probe 重加权局部方向，进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 MLLM 激活 steering 方法通常以全局激活均值作为 steering vector，但任务相关激活往往呈多中心分布：全局均值位于簇间空隙，不能忠实表示任何单一任务，从而导致跨任务干扰和性能不稳定。同时，每个任务纯局部簇中的 steering 信号具有低秩结构，且不同查询任务需要强调不同的局部基方向族。
AI.method: MAST 首先按任务对样本分组，在每个任务组内进行多中心聚类，并为每个簇选择一个代表性 medoid 作为锚点。推理时，查询被路由到多个相关 medoids；对每个匹配簇提取低秩局部 steering direction，再跨簇聚合生成最终 steering vector。MAST-PR 在此基础上引入轻量级任务感知 probe，对任务特化局部方向族进行重加权，以增强不同查询条件下的方向选择能力。
AI.result: MAST 作为训练无关、输入自适应的框架，通过 medoid 锚定的局部低秩子空间聚合缓解全局均值 steering 的跨任务干扰问题；MAST-PR 在 MAST 基础上取得平均 +8.09 分的进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 摘要认为，多模态大模型中任务激活的多中心几何和低秩局部结构是全局均值 steering 失效的重要原因。基于任务分组、多中心 medoid 聚类、局部子空间聚合和 probe 重加权，MAST/MAST-PR 能实现更稳定、更具任务针对性的激活 steering。

title: GingivitisSeg: A Public Dataset and Comparative Benchmark for Gingivitis Segmentation in Intraoral Images
summary: Gingivitis segmentation from intraoral photographs can support computer-assisted periodontal assessment, but pixel-level delineation remains challenging due to severe foreground-background class imbalance, low-contrast boundaries, and variations in illumination and anatomy. We introduce GingivitisSeg, a public benchmark comprising 961 intraoral images with pixel-level annotations of gingival inflammation and predefined training (672), validation (144), and test (145) partitions. Seven semantic segmentation model-backbone configurations were compared using standardized partitions, input resolution, and evaluation metrics. Controlled ablation experiments examined class-weighted cross-entropy loss, Dice loss, and auxiliary supervision. UPerNet with ResNet50 achieved the highest mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 76.49% and gingivitis IoU of 54.91%. However, differences from DeepLabV3+ with ResNet50 and SegFormer with MiT-B2 were not statistically significant after Holm correction. The evaluated optimization components improved performance when combined in the UPerNet-ResNet50 configuration. Further analyses showed that performance was associated with gingivitis region size and decreased under stronger image blur. The dataset, benchmark splits, and source code are available at this https URL.
comment: Preprint. Under review at Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine. Dataset and code: this https URL. Dataset DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21098897

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GingivitisSeg 公开基准数据集（961 张口内照片及像素级牙龈炎标注），系统比较 7 种语义分割配置并开展损失函数与辅助监督消融实验。最优结果为 UPerNet-ResNet50：mIoU 76.49%、牙龈炎 IoU 54.91%，但与 DeepLabV3+-ResNet50、SegFormer-MiT-B2 的差异在 Holm 校正后不显著；性能受病灶区域大小和图像模糊影响。
AI.motivation: 牙龈炎分割可为计算机辅助牙周评估提供像素级依据，但口内图像存在显著的前景-背景类别不平衡、低对比度边界以及光照和解剖结构差异，使精细分割困难；同时该方向缺乏标准化公开基准与统一评测协议，限制了模型比较、复现和临床转化研究。
AI.method: 作者构建包含训练集 672 张、验证集 144 张、测试集 145 张的公开基准数据集，并提供牙龈炎症的像素级标注；在统一的数据划分、输入分辨率和评价指标下比较 7 种语义分割 model-backbone 配置；通过受控消融实验评估类别加权交叉熵损失、Dice 损失和辅助监督的作用；进一步分析性能与牙龈炎区域大小、图像模糊强度的关系，并对模型差异进行 Holm 多重比较校正。
AI.result: UPerNet-ResNet50 取得最高 mIoU 76.49% 和牙龈炎类别 IoU 54.91%；但其与 DeepLabV3+-ResNet50 及 SegFormer-MiT-B2 的差距经 Holm 校正后不具有统计学显著性。所评估的优化组件在 UPerNet-ResNet50 配置中联合使用时可提升性能。额外分析表明，牙龈炎区域越大模型性能越好，而更强的图像模糊会导致性能下降。数据集、划分和代码公开可用。
AI.conclusion: GingivitisSeg 为口内牙龈炎像素级分割提供了标准化、可复现的公开基准；当前最优分割模型能取得有竞争力的结果，但不同强基线之间统计差异有限，且小病灶和模糊图像仍是主要瓶颈。该工作有助于推动牙周评估的计算机辅助研究，但临床落地仍需进一步处理低质量图像和小而模糊炎症区域的分割鲁棒性。

title: OT-BLS: Optimal-Transport-based Backbone Layer Selection for Frozen DINOv3 in Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
summary: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS) aims to segment a target class in images from a previously unseen domain using only a few annotated support examples. Training-free CD-FSS methods, which typically leverage vision foundation models such as DINOv3, achieve competitive performance without parameter updates. However, the optimal DINOv3 layer for mask prediction varies across support--query episodes. Although several layer-selection criteria have been proposed, they do not explicitly evaluate whether the predicted query foreground and background labels agree with the corresponding support labels. To address this limitation, we propose a novel layer-selection criterion, Optimal-Transport-Based Backbone Layer Selection (OT-BLS). Our key insight is that an effective layer-selection criterion can be derived from the optimal-transport correspondence between query and support patch-token features. Based on this insight, we first estimate the transport plan using a well-established optimal transport algorithm and then compute a layer-selection score by aggregating the transported mass according to the foreground--background partition defined by each candidate query mask. The resulting score reflects how well the predicted foreground and background of the query correspond to those of the support. Experiments on eight benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of OT-BLS. It outperforms the conventional last-layer baseline in 12 of 16 dataset/shot settings. Furthermore, OT-BLS improves the average mIoU from 55.72 to 57.62 and achieves a 2.99-point improvement over the best-performing existing layer-selection criterion while running 3.7--14.6$\times$ faster.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Visual Communications and Image Processing (VCIP 2026)

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于最优传输的骨干网络层选择准则 OT-BLS，用于训练无关的跨域小样本分割，以缓解 DINOv3 中不同支持-查询场景下最优预测层变化的问题。
AI.motivation: 跨域小样本分割需要在未见领域中仅用少量支持样本分割目标类别。现有训练无关方法虽利用视觉基础模型获得较好效果，但最优 DINOv3 层会随支持-查询样本对变化；已有层选择准则没有显式评估查询预测的前背景标签是否与支持标签一致，导致层选择不够可靠。
AI.method: 提出最优传输驱动的层选择准则：首先利用成熟最优传输算法估计查询与支持补丁标记特征之间的传输计划，然后根据每个候选查询掩码划分的前背景区域聚合传输质量，得到层选择分数。该分数反映查询预测前背景与支持前背景之间的对应程度，从而选择更适合当前支持-查询场景的骨干层。
AI.result: 在八个基准数据集上验证了 OT-BLS 的有效性：在 16 个数据集/shot 设置中的 12 个优于传统最后一层基线；平均 mIoU 从 55.72 提升到 57.62，较现有最佳层选择准则提升 2.99 点，同时速度提升 3.7 至 14.6 倍。
AI.conclusion: OT-BLS 通过最优传输建立查询支持特征对应关系，实现了更可靠且高效的跨域小样本分割层选择，在精度和速度上均优于已有训练无关方法中的代表性层选择准则。

title: The Neighbour's Label: Opposite Subgroup Effects of Same-Dialogue Exposure in Next-Act Evaluation
summary: Window-based next-act evaluation often aims to measure generalisation across dialogues, yet overlapping windows and similarity retrieval can expose labelled examples from the test dialogue. The nearest such example is the target's labelled predecessor, whose act is correct when the target continues it and wrong when the target changes act; a model that copies it can gain and lose in two subgroups that one aggregate averages. We induce this exposure under controlled designs on SGD, STAR and AMI, whose official splits are clean. Randomly including the predecessor's row in training raises a lexical classifier's continuation scores and lowers its transition scores in all three corpora, and purging the adjacent rows removes most of the gain. With TF-IDF-retrieved demonstrations, two 7B instruction-tuned models show the same opposite pattern in all eight model-corpus-sample arms (some single-cell intervals include zero; one replication is partial), while natural-weight accuracy changes by only -0.05 to +0.04. Exposure frequency depends on the retrieval pipeline. We evaluate two diagnostic comparisons without model retraining and find that excluding the test dialogue does not detectably reduce accuracy on SGD. All exposure is induced; no published system was re-evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了对话下一动作（next-act）评测中由重叠窗口和检索式示例暴露造成的测试信息泄漏：模型的“前驱句”本身可能带有标签，模型复制该标签会在“继续动作”子组获益、在“切换动作”子组受损，从而被单一总体指标掩盖。作者通过可控实验在 SGD、STAR 和 AMI 上验证了这种暴露效应，并提出应更细致地诊断评测管线中的信息暴露。
AI.motivation: 窗口式 next-act 评测通常试图衡量跨对话泛化能力，但重叠窗口和基于相似度的检索可能把同一测试对话中已有标签的示例暴露给模型。最接近目标句的示例往往是其已标注的“前驱句”：若目标句延续前驱动作，则直接复制该动作会得分更高；若目标句切换动作，则复制会导致错误。一个聚合指标可能无法区分这些相反方向的影响，因此需要检查评测数据/检索管线是否存在隐性泄漏。
AI.method: 作者在 SGD、STAR 和 AMI 三个官方划分本身较干净的语料上进行受控诱导实验。首先，在词法分类器中随机将目标句的“前驱句”行加入训练，观察其对“继续动作”和“切换动作”分数的影响；并测试移除相邻行后增益是否消失。其次，使用 TF-IDF 检索为两个 7B 指令微调模型提供少样本示例，检查不同模型—语料—采样组合中是否出现类似的相反模式。最后，提出两种无需重新训练模型的诊断比较，以评估暴露频率是否依赖检索管线，并测试排除测试对话是否会显著降低 SGD 上的准确率。
AI.result: 将前驱句加入训练会使词法分类器在三个语料上的“继续动作”分数升高、而“切换动作”分数下降；移除相邻行会消除大部分增益。对于两个 7B 指令模型，在全部八个模型—语料—样本组合中均观察到相反方向的模式（个别单元格置信区间包含零，其中一次复现仅为部分复现），但总体自然权重准确率变化很小，约为 -0.05 到 +0.04。暴露频率取决于检索管线。诊断比较显示，在 SGD 上排除测试对话并未显著降低模型准确率。所有暴露均为作者诱导产生，未重新评测任何已发表系统。
AI.conclusion: 窗口化和检索式 next-act 评测可能引入隐性测试暴露，使聚合准确率掩盖不同子组间的相反效应。作者没有证明已发表系统因此虚高，但表明可通过可控实验诱导这种偏差，并指出诊断暴露频率比简单排除测试对话更关键。未来应改进评测协议，显式报告子组性能、暴露来源和检索管线影响，以提高 next-act 评测的可解释性与可信度。

title: A General Concept-based Decomposition for Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: Vision-Language Models are designed to capture the compositional structure of the world through multi-modal alignment; however, it remains unclear whether their representations truly align with the way a human would naturally describe the same visual input. Prior works attempt to decompose visual embeddings into their concept-level contributions, but their instance-level optimization is inherently local and does not capture the model's global semantic structure, which is essential for compositional generalization across different inputs, tasks, and domains. We introduce GRACE, a method that learns this concept-based structure at the feature space level, producing semantic and general concept decompositions. To achieve this, we propose a novel training objective that preserves the geometric relations of different samples in the concept space, enabling a better understanding of how concepts compose and relate to each other. We validate GRACE on several image and video benchmarks, showing that its concept decomposition is aligned with human perception and achieves faithful decompositions across different tasks and domains. With minimal overhead, GRACE makes existing Vision-Language Models more interpretable, while preserving most of their original performance.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRACE方法，在特征空间层面学习视觉-语言模型的概念结构，以获得更符合人类感知、语义清晰且可跨任务泛化的概念分解。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型虽通过多模态对齐建模世界的组合结构，但其表征是否真正契合人类对视觉输入的自然描述仍不清楚；已有方法多采用实例级局部优化，难以捕捉模型全局语义结构，不利于跨输入、任务和领域的组合泛化。
AI.method: 提出GRACE，在特征空间层面学习基于概念的结构，并引入新的训练目标，以保留不同样本在概念空间中的几何关系，从而更好理解概念之间的组合与关联，得到语义化且可泛化的概念分解。
AI.result: 在多个图像和视频基准上，GRACE的概念分解与人类感知更一致，并在不同任务和领域中保持较忠实分解，同时以极低额外开销提升现有视觉-语言模型的可解释性，且基本保留原有性能。
AI.conclusion: GRACE为视觉-语言模型提供了更具语义性和泛化性的概念级可解释方法，使模型在保持性能的同时更易理解、更符合人类感知。

title: Where is My Mug? Training-Free Framework for Personalized Image Segmentation
summary: \textbf{Personalized Image Segmentation (PIS)} aims to segment the specific object in a target image that matches a user-provided reference. Unlike category-based segmentation or few-shot segmentation, PIS must discriminate between multiple visually similar instances, a requirement central to deployed applications such as augmented reality, personalized content editing, robotics manipulation, inventory tracking, and fine-grained visual retrieval. We show that the strong numbers reported by existing PIS methods are largely an artifact of single-instance benchmarks: when evaluated on realistic scenes with several same-category look-alikes, prior point-prompt methods collapse, because the correct instance is frequently never surfaced as a prompt. We trace this to a recall bottleneck rather than a mask-quality one, and address it with a training-free, modular system. The pipeline first generates high-recall object proposals using an off-the-shelf class-agnostic detector, then matches each proposal to the reference using foundation-model features (e.g., BLIP-2), and finally refines the selected box with SAM. For robust matching we propose \textbf{top-$K$ Sinkhorn}, a patch-level distance that scores each candidate only on its most confidently matched patches; trimming the Sinkhorn dual potentials recovers the robustness of partial optimal transport at more than $100\times$ lower cost, keeping it inside the per-proposal candidate loop. To evaluate this regime, we introduce \textbf{\datasetname}, a realistic multi-instance benchmark. Across \datasetname, PerSeg, PerMIS, and DAVIS, our system surpasses PerSAM, $\mathrm{P}^2\mathrm{SAM}$, and PDM by up to $\sim\!48$ mIoU while matching their runtime and using fewer parameters, establishing a strong, deployable training-free baseline for real-world personalized segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出个性化图像分割在真实多实例场景中面临召回瓶颈，提出免训练流水线：先用类无关检测器生成高召回候选，再用基础模型特征和 top-K Sinkhorn 匹配参考对象，最后用 SAM 精修分割；并在多实例基准上显著提升现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像分割方法常在单实例基准上取得较高分数，但在真实场景中若同一类别存在多个相似实例，点提示方法往往无法召回正确实例。作者认为主要瓶颈是实例召回不足，而非分割掩码质量不足，因此需要构建更鲁棒的多实例评测和检索匹配机制。
AI.method: 提出免训练、模块化系统：第一步利用现成类无关目标检测器生成高召回候选区域；第二步用基础模型视觉特征（如 BLIP-2）将每个候选与用户参考图匹配；为提升匹配鲁棒性，提出 top-K Sinkhorn patch-level distance，仅基于最可靠匹配的 patch 给候选打分，并通过裁剪 Sinkhorn 对偶势近似部分最优传输的鲁棒性，同时保持约百倍更低计算成本；第三步用 SAM 对选中的边界框进行掩码精修。
AI.result: 在提出的多实例基准以及 PerSeg、PerMIS 和 DAVIS 上，该系统超过 PerSAM、P²SAM 和 PDM 等现有方法，mIoU 提升最高约 48%，同时保持相近运行时间并使用更少参数，形成可部署的免训练强基线。
AI.conclusion: 个性化图像分割的关键瓶颈之一是多实例场景下的正确候选召回；通过高召回候选生成、鲁棒 patch 匹配和 SAM 精修的组合，可以在不训练模型的情况下显著提升真实多实例个性化分割性能。

title: Driving World Models Move the Camera, Not the Scene
summary: Plan-conditioned driving world models are used to compare candidate plans, so their forecast should change with the plan as the real scene would, yet widely used control metrics check only whether the camera follows the command. Recorded drives already contain real outcomes of plans that were never driven: retiming a log gives pose-matched images and LiDAR for other speeds, and a stereo rig records a laterally shifted view. Against these references, released world models move their camera but barely move the scene: their scene response, the share of the real change in distance that the forecast reproduces, reaches at most about a third of real video's, and the trajectory score cannot tell an executed speed command from an ignored one. Interventions inside the generator trace the failure to the plan's channel. The forecast geometry follows the context frames; once they carry the planned geometry, plan tokens add little. ReTime-Compose therefore delivers the plan as geometry, without training. It transports the frames of one logged-speed rollout to the planned cameras, and the frozen model completes only what no frame covers. Frozen generators then follow a 0.54 m lateral shift nearly as the real scene does on KITTI, nuScenes and Argoverse 2, and respond more than re-sampling to slow-down plans in three generators and to speed-up plans in two.

AI.tldr: 本文针对计划条件驾驶世界模型，提出利用已有行车记录构造“未执行计划”的真实反事实参考，评估预测是否会随驾驶计划改变场景；发现现有模型主要只控制相机轨迹、场景响应较弱，并提出免训练的 ReTime-Compose，将计划以几何形式注入冻结生成器，以显著提升计划对应的场景变化能力。
AI.motivation: 计划条件驾驶世界模型应能比较不同驾驶计划的真实后果，即预测内容需要随速度、横向偏移等计划而变化。然而现有控制指标往往只检查相机是否按照指令移动，无法判断场景是否产生真实变化。需要构造与计划匹配的参考数据来评估反事实场景响应，并定位模型对计划不敏感的原因。
AI.method: 1. 从录制驾驶日志中构造反事实参考：通过重定时得到与计划速度匹配的位姿对齐图像和 LiDAR，通过立体相机得到横向偏移视图。 2. 定义“场景响应”指标，衡量模型预测能复现多少真实场景中由计划造成的距离变化。 3. 对生成器内部进行干预，分析相机、上下文帧与 plan token 的作用，发现预测几何主要跟随上下文帧，plan token 贡献有限。 4. 提出 ReTime-Compose：不重新训练，先将一次记录速度下的 rollout 帧按计划相机几何传输到目标位姿，再让冻结世界模型仅补全未被覆盖的区域。
AI.result: 已有开源世界模型虽然能移动相机，但场景几乎不变，其场景响应最高约为真实视频的三分之一，轨迹评分也无法区分速度指令是被执行还是被忽略。引入 ReTime-Compose 后，冻结生成器在 KITTI、nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 上能接近真实场景地响应约 0.54 m 的横向位移；对减速计划在三个生成器上响应更强，对加速计划在两个生成器上优于重新采样基线。
AI.conclusion: 现有计划条件驾驶世界模型的关键问题是缺少真正的计划场景响应：相机受控但场景未随计划改变。将计划表达为几何条件、采用免训练的帧传输与补全机制，可以显著增强模型对反事实驾驶计划的表现。该工作表明，驾驶世界模型的评估应从“相机是否跟随指令”扩展到“场景是否随计划真实变化”。

title: Track4D: Representing Dense 3D Tracking for Video Diffusion Models
summary: We study how to repurpose video diffusion models (VDMs), pretrained on millions of videos, for dense 3D point tracking, where training data is scarce. Doing so is non-trivial, as it requires representing 3D tracks as video-like signals that may lie outside the natural-video distribution on which the VDM was trained. We thus systematically assess the effectiveness of two such video representations. The first, Residual 3D Tracking Video (RTV), encodes per-pixel 3D offsets relative to a query frame and allows recovery of 3D trajectories directly from the generated video. The second, Normalized Coordinate Map Video (NCMV), labels each pixel with a canonical coordinate invariant through time. This is closer to a natural video and easier for the VDM to learn, but requires additional post-processing with an off-the-shelf 2D tracker to recover 3D tracks. RTV tracks more accurately, while NCMV shows that a VDM can generate dense correspondence as a video. We instantiate both representations with LoRA adaptation of a frozen Wan backbone, conditioned on point maps from an off-the-shelf 3D reconstructor as a geometric scaffold. Trained with a single dynamic 3D tracking dataset, Track4D achieves competitive zero-shot tracking on four real and synthetic benchmarks. A regression readout that bypasses the video VAE and uses additional training data brings further improvement, demonstrating the potential of this direction for dense 3D tracking. We hope our analysis will inspire future work that leverages VDM priors for dense 3D tracking and 4D reconstruction. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究将预训练视频扩散模型（VDM）复用于稠密3D点跟踪，通过把3D轨迹编码为类视频表示，并使用LoRA微调冻结的Wan主干和几何条件输入，在单一3D动态跟踪数据集上训练即可实现竞争性的零样本稠密3D跟踪。
AI.motivation: 稠密3D点跟踪的训练数据稀缺，而视频扩散模型已在大规模视频上预训练，蕴含丰富的视觉运动与时空先验。关键难点在于：如何把3D轨迹表示为视频信号，同时尽量保持可学习性和与预训练VDM分布的兼容性。
AI.method: 作者提出并系统比较两种视频化表示：1）残差3D跟踪视频（RTV），编码每个像素相对于查询帧的3D偏移，可直接从生成视频恢复3D轨迹；2）归一化坐标图视频（NCMV），为每个像素标注时间不变的正则化坐标，更接近自然视频但需结合现成2D跟踪器进行后处理。进一步基于冻结的Wan VDM主干，使用LoRA适配，并以现成3D重建器生成的点图作为几何条件，得到Track4D框架；同时提出绕过视频VAE的回归读出头以提升精度。
AI.result: 实验表明：RTV的跟踪精度更高，而NCMV证明了VDM能够以视频形式生成稠密对应。仅使用单一动态3D跟踪数据集训练的Track4D，在四个真实与合成基准上取得了竞争性的零样本跟踪表现；额外的回归读出和利用更多训练数据可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练视频扩散模型转化为稠密3D跟踪生成器是可行且有效的方向。RTV更适合直接3D轨迹恢复，NCMV更接近自然视频分布但依赖后处理；通过LoRA与几何条件注入，VDM先验可显著缓解3D跟踪数据稀缺问题，并为稠密3D跟踪和4D重建提供了新的研究路径。

title: Beyond the Explicit: Benchmarking and Detecting Implicit Harm in Short Videos
summary: Short videos have become a dominant online medium, where harmful content is increasingly conveyed in implicit and fragmented forms. Prior work largely focuses on explicit categories, such as violence and hate speech, and often fails to detect videos that subtly promote misleading values through narrative context, emotional framing, or cross-modal cues, partly due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks for implicit harm. To bridge this gap, we construct DeepHarm-7K, a large-scale harmful short-video dataset comprising 7,110 samples annotated according to a fine-grained harmful-content taxonomy. The dataset systematically covers implicitly harmful videos across diverse real-world scenarios and is constructed through a rigorous multi-stage quality-control process. Building on this dataset, we propose DeepHarm-VL, a multimodal detection framework that integrates visual, audio, and cross-modal reasoning. The framework employs a two-round reasoning strategy to progressively identify surface-level evidence and infer latent harmful implications. Experimental results show consistent improvements over strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods across multiple open-source video-language models, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting both explicit and implicit harmful short videos.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了大规模隐式有害短视频基准DeepHarm-7K，并提出多模态检测框架DeepHarm-VL，通过两轮推理联合利用视觉、音频与跨模态线索，提升对显式和隐式有害内容的识别能力。
AI.motivation: 短视频中的有害内容日益以隐式、碎片化方式呈现，现有研究多关注暴力、仇恨言论等显式类别，难以识别通过叙事语境、情绪包装或跨模态暗示传递的误导性价值观，且缺乏专门面向隐式有害视频的大规模基准。
AI.method: 论文首先构建DeepHarm-7K数据集，包含7,110个样本，并基于细粒度有害内容分类体系进行标注，覆盖多种真实场景中的隐式有害视频，同时采用多阶段质量控制流程保证标注可靠性。随后提出DeepHarm-VL多模态检测框架，整合视觉、音频及跨模态信息，并设计两轮推理策略：第一轮识别表面层证据，第二轮推断潜在有害含义。
AI.result: 在多个开源视频语言模型上的实验表明，DeepHarm-VL相较强基线和现有最先进方法取得一致提升，能够有效检测显式与隐式有害短视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过新数据集与多模态两轮推理框架，为短视频隐式有害内容检测提供了更可靠的基准与方法支撑，说明结合视觉、音频和深层语义推理对于识别复杂、间接的有害传播具有重要价值。

title: Arbor: When Labels Are Not Coarsened at Random
summary: Merging datasets labelled at different levels of a taxonomy leaves some images with only a coarse label, and some classes with no fine-grained label at all. Standard training scores a coarse label by the total probability of the classes under it. Coarse labels name superclasses, and the standard objective is exact only when every class within a superclass is equally likely to receive a coarse label. We call a class novel if it is never labelled finely, and known otherwise. A novel class violates the assumption, and the classifier assigns its images to a known sibling. We propose Arbor, which models how labels become coarse. In each superclass with a novel class, Arbor adds a virtual novel class, and a logistic gate divides the superclass's probability between it and the known classes. The gate is trained with the likelihood of the observed labels under this model, the coarsening likelihood. We prove that at its population optimum the gate equals the Elkan-Noto correction of positive-unlabelled learning, and show that training the correction into the classifier improves on applying it after training. Across Cars, CUB and Aircraft with 90% coarse labels, Arbor correctly assigns 76-85% of novel-class images to their superclass, more than hierarchical classifiers, hierarchical novelty detection and the Elkan-Noto correction. Its top-1 accuracy over the leaf classes on known-class images is within 1.6 points of the best baseline, although its final predictions return the superclass more often. On the more challenging iNaturalist-2019 benchmark, Arbor improves novel-class accuracy from 46% (uniform target, the strongest baseline) to 68%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Arbor方法，用于解决层级分类中粗标签与细标签混合、且部分细粒度类别从未被显式标注（novel class）所带来的偏差问题。Arbor在超类内部引入虚拟新类与可学习门控，以建模标签从细粒度到粗粒度的“粗化”过程，从而更准确地识别和归位未见细类的样本。
AI.motivation: 在实际数据合并场景中，不同数据集可能标注在不同分类层级：有些图像只有粗类标签，有些细类完全没有细标签。标准做法将粗类得分设为其下所有细类概率之和，但这一目标仅在超类内每个细类被粗化到的概率相同时才准确。若存在从未被细标注的“新类”，该假设被打破，分类器倾向把新类图像错误归入已知兄弟类，从而降低层级分类和开放识别能力。
AI.method: 作者提出Arbor，显式建模“标签如何变粗”。对于包含未见细类的超类，Arbor增加一个虚拟新类，并用logistic gate将超类总概率在虚拟新类与已知细类之间分配。该门控通过观测标签在粗化模型下的似然（coarsening likelihood）进行训练。论文证明在总体最优解处，该门控等价于正未标注学习中的Elkan-Noto校正，并且将该校正内化到分类器训练阶段，比训练后再做校正更有效。
AI.result: 在Cars、CUB和Aircraft数据集、且90%标签为粗标签的设置下，Arbor能够把76%–85%的未细标注类样本正确分配到其超类，优于层级分类器、层级新类检测和Elkan-Noto校正。尽管最终预测更常返回超类，它在已知类上的细类top-1准确率仍与最佳基线差距不超过1.6个百分点。在更具挑战性的iNaturalist-2019上，Arbor将新类准确率从46%提升到68%。
AI.conclusion: Arbor通过建模粗标签生成过程并在超类内部引入虚拟新类与门控校正，有效缓解了混合层级标注中“从未细标注类”被误归到已知兄弟类的问题。相比事后应用Elkan-Noto校正，将粗化模型直接纳入训练能显著提升对未细标注类的识别与归超类能力，同时基本保持已知类的细粒度分类性能。

title: AcrossPlace: Do Vision--Language Models Recognize Places Beyond Their Source Views? A Comprehensive Benchmark
summary: Language-guided place recognition requires recovering geographic identity across visual observations beyond the image from which a description originates. However, aggregate retrieval scores often entangle observation transfer, gallery competition, and linguistic evidence, obscuring the underlying recognition capability. We introduce AcrossPlace, a provenance-aware benchmark establishing a systematic evaluation standard for bidirectional language--vision place recognition. Built upon GSV-Cities, AcrossPlace comprises 56,726 places across 23 cities, 156,800 automatically generated, rule-filtered descriptions, and 113,404 target images. Each description retains its source-image provenance, while retrieval operates on disjoint target observations. Text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) retrieval share a unified place-identity relevance criterion supporting multiple valid matches. Two geographic protocols evaluate unseen places within represented cities (P0) and generalization to held-out cities (P1). Paired observation comparisons, gallery-controlled evaluations, fixed-query scaling, and blinded annotation auditing systematically characterize retrieval performance. Across three training seeds, place-supervised SigLIP2 T2I Recall@1 decreases from 19.69% on source images to 12.31% on independent targets under P0. For fixed P1 queries, expanding the gallery from 500 to 8,425 places reduces Recall@1 from 14.67% to 2.87%. A 240-description audit further reveals discrepancies between automated acceptance and factual evidence. These findings establish AcrossPlace as a reproducible evaluation standard for assessing transferable place identity across visual observations and geographic environments.

AI.tldr: AcrossPlace is a provenance-aware benchmark for evaluating transferable place identity recognition in bidirectional language-vision place retrieval, separating source descriptions from target observations and exposing the confounding effects of gallery scale and evidence grounding.
AI.motivation: Existing language-guided place recognition evaluations often aggregate retrieval scores that mix cross-observation transfer, gallery competition, and textual evidence strength, making it difficult to reveal whether a model truly recognizes the same geographic place from different visual views. A controlled, provenance-aware benchmark is needed to assess bidirectional place-level recognition more transparently.
AI.method: The authors build AcrossPlace on GSV-Cities with 56,726 places across 23 cities, 156,800 automatically generated and rule-filtered descriptions, and 113,404 target images. Each description keeps its source-image provenance, but retrieval is performed on disjoint target observations. Unified place-identity relevance supports multiple valid matches for both text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval. Two geographic protocols are used: P0 tests unseen places within represented cities, and P1 tests generalization to held-out cities. Evaluation includes paired observation comparisons, gallery-controlled settings, fixed-query gallery scaling, and blinded annotation auditing.
AI.result: Place-supervised SigLIP2 shows degraded text-to-image Recall@1 when moving from source images to independent target images: from 19.69% to 12.31% under P0. Under P1, increasing the gallery from 500 to 8,425 places reduces Recall@1 from 14.67% to 2.87%. A 240-description audit reveals mismatches between automated acceptance criteria and actual factual evidence.
AI.conclusion: AcrossPlace provides a reproducible and diagnostic evaluation standard for language-guided place recognition. It shows that reported retrieval scores can be inflated by source-image matching and small-gallery effects, while robust transferable place identity recognition across independent visual observations and unseen geographic environments remains challenging and requires stronger evidence grounding.

title: Vision-Grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment for Scalable Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval
summary: Multilingual Text-Based Person Retrieval (TBPR) aims to retrieve individuals with texts in multiple languages. Despite its practical importance, it has been overlooked by existing research, which mainly focuses on English-only retrieval. The only prior attempt at multilingual TBPR suffers from (1) the absence of a large-scale, multilingual pretraining dataset and (2) a suboptimal model architecture for multilingual text encoding and cross-modal alignment, which employs a shared encoder that overlooks linguistic heterogeneity and relies on English as a pivot for cross-modal alignment, introducing English-centric bias. For this, we contribute MultiPedes, the first large-scale, pedestrian-centric multilingual pretraining dataset. It contains 10 million image-text pairs across four languages, constructed by a multilingual quality-aware data construction pipeline. We also propose ViSeLA (Vision-grounded Semantic Learning and Alignment), a novel framework featuring: (1) a semantic-aware multilingual learning module that extends the mixture-of-experts architecture by routing language-invariant semantics to specialized experts for improved multilingual feature learning; and (2) a vision-grounded cross-modal alignment module that employs a semantic probe to capture fine-grained semantics across modalities, enabling direct cross-modal alignment without relying on a pivot language. Extensive experiments on both multilingual and English-only TBPR datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ViSeLA. The dataset and code are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文针对多语言文本行人检索（Multilingual TBPR）数据集缺乏与模型偏置问题，提出首个大规模多语言行人图文预训练数据集 MultiPedes，并设计 ViSeLA 框架，通过语义感知混合专家模块和视觉接地跨模态对齐模块提升多语言文本编码与图文检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本行人检索研究主要集中于英语单语言场景，忽略了多语言实际需求。此前仅有的多语言 TBPR 尝试存在两大问题：一是缺少大规模多语言预训练数据；二是模型架构次优，使用共享编码器难以建模语言异质性，并依赖英语作为跨模态对齐枢轴，导致英语中心偏差和性能受限。
AI.method: 作者构建 MultiPedes 数据集，包含来自四种语言的 1000 万级图文对，并通过多语言质量感知数据构建流程保证数据质量。模型方面提出 ViSeLA 框架，包括两部分：其一，语义感知多语言学习模块，将混合专家（MoE）架构扩展为根据语言无关语义路由到不同专家，以增强多语言特征学习；其二，视觉接地的跨模态对齐模块，利用语义探针捕获跨模态细粒度语义，实现不依赖英语等枢轴语言的直接图文对齐。
AI.result: 在多语言以及仅英语的文本行人检索数据集上进行大量实验，表明 ViSeLA 框架具有有效性。同时，MultiPedes 数据集和代码已开源，可为多语言 TBPR 研究提供预训练资源和可复现基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了多语言文本行人检索在大规模数据集和强模型架构方面的空白。MultiPedes 提供了大规模多语言行人图文预训练基础，ViSeLA 通过语言不变语义路由和视觉接地对齐缓解了共享编码器与英语中心偏置问题，为跨语言图文检索提供了更具泛化性的方案。

title: CARE-Drive: Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CARE-Drive，将端到端自动驾驶轨迹精修分解为“位置残差修正专家”和“位置条件航向生成专家”，并通过交替训练与耦合建模提升轨迹质量；在 NAVSIM v1 上达到 88.8 PDMS。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 轨迹精修方法多对整条轨迹进行统一修正，较少区分位置和航向等不同物理量及其相互作用，导致精修过程不够直观、物理语义不够明确。
AI.method: CARE-Drive 以冻结的 VLA 骨干网络作为基础预测器，通过模仿学习和未来 token 辅助任务生成基础轨迹与预测表征；随后引入两个物理专门化专家：位置专家预测有界度量航点残差，航向专家基于修正后的路径从相邻角增量重建车辆朝向。两个专家先进行监督初始化，再通过强化微调交替优化，在预测和优化过程中保留位置与航向的条件耦合。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM v1 基准上，CARE-Drive 达到 88.8 PDMS，相比同一骨干网络生成的未精修基础轨迹提升 2.4 分；消融实验进一步验证了专门化专家设计和分阶段训练策略的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过位置与航向的物理专门化精修，并在预测和优化中保持二者条件耦合，能够以更简洁直观的方式提升端到端自动驾驶轨迹质量，体现出结构化精修在 VLA 模型中的有效性。

title: ChartGalaxy++: A Richly Annotated Dataset for Chart Understanding and Generation
summary: Infographic charts communicate data through cohesive compositions of visual elements such as charts, text, and images. Existing infographic chart datasets primarily annotate individual elements with bounding boxes and category labels. Such element-level annotations do not capture hierarchical and spatial relationships, limiting their use for understanding how elements are organized and related within an infographic and for generating well-organized designs. To address this limitation, we introduce ChartGalaxy++, a richly annotated dataset of 217,195 infographic charts. At the core of this dataset is a scene graph representation, in which nodes represent visual elements and semantic groups, and edges encode their hierarchical and spatial relationships. For real infographics, we construct scene graphs by detecting and progressively grouping visual elements; for synthetic ones, we derive them directly from the generation process. We demonstrate the utility of ChartGalaxy++ through three applications: 1) image-to-scene-graph prediction, 2) scene-graph-augmented infographic question answering, and 3) evaluation of scene graph preservation in image generation. Together, these applications highlight the value of ChartGalaxy++ for advancing chart understanding and generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ChartGalaxy++，一个包含 217,195 张信息图图表的大规模数据集，以场景图为核心标注形式，显式表示视觉元素、语义组及其层级与空间关系，从而支持信息图理解和生成任务。
AI.motivation: 现有信息图数据集多采用元素级边界框和类别标签，难以表达元素之间的组织关系、层级结构、语义分组和空间关系，限制了对信息图布局逻辑的理解以及高质量、结构化信息图的生成。
AI.method: 作者构建基于场景图的标注：节点表示视觉元素或语义分组，边表示层级与空间关系。对真实信息图，先检测视觉元素，再逐步分组形成场景图；对合成信息图，直接从生成过程导出场景图。随后设计三类应用进行验证：图像到场景图预测、场景图增强的信息图问答，以及图像生成中场景图保持能力评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，场景图标注能够提升信息图结构化理解、关系推理和生成质量，验证了 ChartGalaxy++ 在图表理解与生成研究中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: ChartGalaxy++ 通过富语义、关系级的场景图标注弥补了传统元素级标注的不足，为信息图布局理解、问答和生成提供了重要数据基础和评测基准。

title: Learning Motion-Appearance Coupling Priors for Solving Video Inverse Problems
summary: Reconstructing video from degraded measurements requires priors that capture both frame appearance and temporal dynamics. Many recent approaches combine pretrained image diffusion priors with motion guidance, sidestepping the costs of training large video models. Temporal consistency is often enforced via photometric losses or warping-based constraints, which implicitly assume that motion explains frame-to-frame or latent-to-latent changes up to small deviations, an assumption that fails under occlusions, lighting changes, and non-rigid deformation. In this paper, we propose to learn the coupling between motion and frame appearance as a generative prior. We learn the distribution of motion-induced appearance residuals with a conditional diffusion model and use it to regularize reconstruction in video inverse problems. Our motion-appearance prior acts as a plug-in regularizer for diffusion-based video reconstruction, preserving the benefits of image diffusion models while remaining compatible with existing appearance regularization techniques. Experiments on dynamic video inverse problems show that reconstruction with a learnt motion-appearance coupling prior outperforms photometric-consistency and noise-warping baselines, and that the approach also transfers to cardiac MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将“运动诱发的外观残差分布”作为条件扩散生成先验，用于视频逆问题中的重建正则化，以替代依赖运动完全解释帧间变化的光度或warping约束，从而提升遮挡、光照变化和非刚性形变下的时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 许多视频重建方法使用预训练图像扩散先验结合运动引导，以避免训练大规模视频模型。但其时序一致性常通过光度损失或基于warping的约束实现，隐含假设帧间或潜空间变化主要由运动解释，在遮挡、光照变化和非刚性形变等复杂动态场景中容易失效。因此需要一种能建模运动与外观耦合关系的生成先验。
AI.method: 作者学习运动与帧外观之间的耦合关系，将其建模为生成先验。具体地，使用条件扩散模型学习由运动引起的“外观残差”分布，并将该分布作为即插即用正则项，应用于基于扩散模型的视频逆问题重建。该方法保留图像扩散先验的优势，同时可与现有外观正则化技术兼容。
AI.result: 在动态视频逆问题实验中，学习到的运动-外观耦合先验优于传统光度一致性基线和噪声warping基线。此外，该方法还能迁移到心脏MRI重建任务中，显示出一定的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 将运动诱发的外观残差建模为条件扩散生成先验，可以更准确地刻画视频帧间外观变化，缓解运动假设过强的问题，从而在复杂动态视频重建中提升质量，并具备向相关医学影像重建任务迁移的潜力。

title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
summary: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 IncR-3DSGG，一种仅使用带位姿 RGB 图像、无需深度传感器或已重建几何的增量式 3D 场景图生成方法；其核心是通过参数化关系预测器估计物体间的距离与相对角度，并利用位姿图优化获得具有米制一致性的 3D 场景图。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 场景图生成方法通常在推理阶段依赖深度感知，例如通过点云重叠关联跨视角物体，或利用几何线索计算物体间关系，这限制了其在仅具备 RGB 相机或深度传感器缺失平台上的部署。因此，作者希望证明仅从带位姿的 RGB 图像也能预测物体关系和具有米制意义的 3D 物体表示。
AI.method: 该方法首先使用视觉 SLAM 系统估计相机外参，并基于带位姿的 RGB 图像增量式构建 3D 场景图。其关键组件是 Parametric Relation Predictor（PRP），它从 2D 视觉特征和 2D 几何线索中学习预测物体对之间的 pairwise distances 和 relative angles，而 3D 几何监督仅在训练阶段提供。随后，方法将跨视角预测的成对测量通过 Pose Graph Optimization（PGO）进行融合，恢复具有米制一致性的 3D 物体位置，并增量式生成全局一致的 3D 场景图。
AI.result: 在真实场景数据集 3RScan 上，按照 3DSSG 评测协议，该方法取得 52.2 的平均物体召回率和 30.8 的平均谓词召回率，明显优于 MonoSSG 的 27.0 和 17.6；同时推理阶段不使用深度传感器，也不依赖重建后的几何信息。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，仅依靠带位姿的 RGB 图像，也可以通过学习跨视角成对几何关系并加以全局优化，预测物体间关系和具有米制一致性的 3D 物体表示，从而为无深度传感器场景中的 3D 场景图构建提供了可行方案。

title: Verifier Choice is a Benchmark Design Variable: Auditing Structural Counting Evaluation in Text-to-Image Models
summary: Automatic evaluation is now central to text-to-image benchmarking, but the verifier that converts generated images into scores is often treated as an implementation detail. We argue that this is unsafe: an automatic benchmark score is a property of the image generator, prompt distribution, verifier, verifier-use protocol, and scoring rule, not of the generator alone. We study this issue in structural counting, a controlled setting where human-visible counts can be audited. We construct a verifier-centric audit suite over seven counting objects: cell phones, chairs, and traffic lights for object counting, and clover leaflets, dresser drawer fronts, power-strip sockets, and turbine blades for substructure counting. Across 6,240 generated images from Qwen-Image-2512 and FLUX.2-dev, we compare open MLLM verifiers under count-only, reject-aware, zero-shot and few-shot protocols, plus TIFA-like target queries, a detector baseline, and frontier closed-model checks on two hard objects. On a balanced 2,280-image evaluation split, aggregate score matching can coexist with image-level disagreement, and verifier-use protocols and generator distributions change the measured reliability. Every verifier-protocol configuration also shrinks the human score difference between the two generators, by 7.5-25.0 pp, and with a third generator, Z-Image, all four tested protocols reverse the human ordering of Z-Image and FLUX.2-dev on our fixed prompt suite. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 checks do not remove the failure modes: GPT-5.5 still has only 59.92% clover valid-count fidelity, while Claude Opus 4.7 has lower same-slice agreement ($\kappa=0.432$). We propose reporting automatic benchmark scores with a factorized verifier reliability profile: aggregate score gap, image-level agreement, generator-comparison distortion, valid-image count fidelity, rejection behavior, output compliance, and directional bias.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注文生图自动评测中的“验证器”角色，主张自动 benchmark 分数并不只由生成模型决定，而是由生成器、提示分布、验证器、验证器使用协议和评分规则共同决定；并通过结构化计数任务构建验证器中心的审计套件，揭示自动评分与人类判断之间可能存在的偏差与排序失真。
AI.motivation: 当前文生图基准评测高度依赖自动验证器，但验证器常被视为实现细节。论文认为这会导致不可靠结论：相同图像在人类眼中可能明显优于另一图像，但自动评分可能掩盖图像级不一致、压缩生成器差距，甚至反转模型优劣排序。因此需要系统分析验证器及其使用协议如何影响基准分数和模型比较。
AI.method: 论文选择“结构计数”作为可人工审计的受控评测任务，覆盖七类计数对象：手机、椅子、交通灯用于物体计数，三叶草小叶、抽屉面板、插线板插孔、涡轮叶片用于子结构计数。基于 Qwen-Image-2512 和 FLUX.2-dev 生成 6,240 张图像，构建验证器中心的审计套件，并比较多种验证设置，包括开放 MLLM 验证器、仅计数协议、拒绝感知协议、零样本与少样本协议、TIFA 风格目标查询、检测器基线，以及在两类困难对象上引入前沿闭源模型检查。最终在 2,280 张图像的均衡评测集上分析自动分数、图像级一致性、生成器比较和失败模式。
AI.result: 结果显示，聚合层面的分数匹配可以与图像层面的明显不一致并存；验证器使用协议和生成器分布会显著改变测得可靠性。所有验证器-协议配置都会压缩 Qwen-Image-2512 与 FLUX.2-dev 在人类评分中的差距，幅度为 7.5 至 25.0 个百分点。引入第三个生成器 Z-Image 后，四种测试协议均在其与 FLUX.2-dev 的固定提示套件上反转人类排序。前沿闭源模型检查不能消除失败模式：GPT-5.5 在三叶草任务上的有效计数保真度仅 59.92%，Claude Opus 4.7 在同一数据切片上的一致性较低，κ = 0.432。
AI.conclusion: 自动基准分数是“生成器—数据—验证器—协议—评分规则”的系统属性，而非图像生成器本身的固有属性。为提升文生图评测可靠性，论文建议报告因子化的验证器可靠性档案，包括聚合分差、图像级一致性、生成器比较失真、有效计数保真度、拒绝行为、输出遵循性和方向性偏差，从而让自动评分结果更透明、可审计、可复现。

title: ThermalSplat: Generalizable Pose-Free Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Thermal 3D Reconstruction
summary: Thermal infrared imaging is vital for applications like search-and-rescue and autonomous navigation, yet trans- lating it into 3D scene representations remains a critical bottleneck. The low-texture nature and view-dependent emissivity of thermal images cause standard pose estima- tors to fail catastrophically, collapsing standard 3D Gaus- sian Splatting pipelines under sparse-view constraints. Fur- thermore, existing thermal reconstruction methods rely heavily on dense capture and computationally expensive per-scene optimization. Critically, many of these ap- proaches depend on aligned RGB-thermal datasets to ob- tain reliable camera poses and initial point clouds, ren- dering them unusable in purely thermal, unposed envi- ronments. To break this bottleneck, we present Thermal- Splat, the first generalizable, feed-forward Gaussian splat- ting framework that reconstructs 3D scenes directly from sparse thermal images without requiring known camera poses, RGB guidance, or per-scene training. We over- come thermal-specific challenges using a soft census loss for brightness-invariant structural matching and a bound- ary structure loss to explicitly supervise temperature discon- tinuities. Trained on an aggregated multi-source dataset, ThermalSplat synthesizes sharp reconstructions of unseen scenes in a single feed-forward pass. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that ThermalSplat holds a strict advan- tage over scene-specific thermal splatting methods in the sparse regime. Furthermore, even compared against these baselines operating under their ideal dense capture set- tings, ThermalSplat achieves superior perceptual fidelity. By eliminating the need for computationally expensive per scene optimization, ThermalSplat offers an efficient and generalizable approach to thermal 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出 ThermalSplat，首个面向稀疏未标定热红外图像的可泛化前馈高斯泼溅框架，无需已知位姿、RGB 引导或逐场景优化即可重建三维场景。
AI.motivation: 热红外图像纹理弱、发射率随视角变化，导致常规位姿估计失败和 3D 高斯泼溅在稀疏视角下崩溃；现有热重建方法依赖稠密采集、昂贵逐场景优化，且常需 RGB-热对齐数据获取位姿与初始点云，无法用于纯热红外无位姿场景。
AI.method: 引入软普查损失（soft census loss）实现亮度不变的结构匹配，并引入边界结构损失显式监督温度不连续区域；在聚合多源数据集上训练，以单趟前馈网络直接从稀疏热图像生成高斯泼溅场景表示。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角条件下严格优于逐场景优化的热高斯泼溅基线；即使与基线在理想稠密采集设置下相比，也在感知保真度上取得优势，并避免昂贵的逐场景优化。
AI.conclusion: ThermalSplat 通过可泛化的前馈建模和热红外专属约束，在无需位姿、RGB 或逐场景训练的条件下实现高效热三维重建，为真实纯热成像场景提供了实用方案。

title: SteinPnP: Non-Parametric Uncertainty Quantification in the Perspective-N-Point Problem
summary: We propose SteinPnP, a probabilistic Perspective- N-Point (PnP) solver that models the full 6-DoF camera pose posterior using a non-parametric set of pose particles. By lever- aging Stein Variational Inference (SVI), SteinPnP combines the expressivity of particle-based representations with the efficiency of optimization-based solvers. However, a naive application of SVI struggles in the PnP problem, often missing alternative pose hypotheses or assigning incorrect probability weights to them. To address these limitations, we propose practical remedies that discover new potential poses, identify distinct hypothesis clusters, and balance their relative probability weights to capture the true underlying distribution. Our experiments across synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SteinPnP accurately captures complex multimodal uncertainties while maintaining competitive accuracy.

AI.tldr: SteinPnP是一种基于Stein变分推断的概率型PnP求解器，通过粒子集合近似相机6自由度位姿后验，提升对多模态位姿不确定性的建模能力。
AI.motivation: 传统PnP求解器通常给出单一位姿解，难以表达观测噪声、歧义和几何约束下的多模态不确定性；直接应用粒子式变分推断又容易漏掉有效位姿假设或错误分配其概率权重。
AI.method: 提出SteinPnP，使用非参数位姿粒子集合表示完整6-DoF位姿后验，并利用Stein变分推断结合粒子表示的表达性与优化式求解器的效率；进一步引入发现潜在新位姿、识别不同假设簇以及平衡相对概率权重的机制，以修正朴素SVI在PnP问题中的不足。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准上的实验表明，SteinPnP能够准确刻画复杂的多模位姿不确定性，同时保持有竞争力的位姿估计精度。
AI.conclusion: SteinPnP将粒子式后验推断与PnP优化求解有效结合，为概率相机位姿估计提供了一种能够处理多模态解和不确定性权重失衡的可行方案。

title: Semantic Consistency of Vision Tokens: A Vision-Centric Perspective on Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: In computer vision, vision-language and self-supervised encoders are two unique paradigms characterized by global language alignment and high-quality vision-only patch representations, respectively. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often use the former because of language alignment, despite the recent rise in vision-centric tasks resembling traditional dense vision tasks that would likely benefit from the high-quality patch representations, raising the question whether self-supervised models could aid MLLMs in vision-centric tasks. To investigate this, we define semantic (in)consistency of patch tokens from language-aligned encoders and identify two sets of tokens, semantically consistent (SCTs) and semantically inconsistent (SITs). Through systematic probing via the removal of SCTs or SITs from the input of modern MLLMs, we show higher reliance on SCTs than SITs, as removal of the former induces larger performance drops. This demonstrates that MLLMs benefit from semantic consistency of vision tokens. With this in mind, we devise a simple yet effective extension of the MLLM training objective that combines traditional language modeling with semantic guidance via minimization of semantic inconsistency. This strategy, named Semantically-Guided Training (SGT), combines the signals of both loss terms to push the vision encoder towards providing semantically consistent tokens, while preserving language alignment. Extensive evaluation shows that SGT outperforms all baselines and MLLMs with specialized vision encoders on vision-centric benchmarks while keeping strong scores on text-centric benchmarks, thus setting state of the art on average across all tasks. Our results highlight the importance of combining language alignment and semantic consistency through the lens of MLLMs rather than independently from them and pave the way towards the design of better MLLM vision encoders.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现多模态大语言模型（MLLM）更依赖视觉补丁 token 的语义一致性，并提出语义引导训练（SGT），在保留语言对齐的同时提升 MLLM 的视觉中心任务表现。
AI.motivation: MLLM 通常采用视觉-语言对齐编码器以获得语言相关性，但视觉中心任务更需要高质量的局部 patch 表示；论文旨在探究自监督式高质量视觉表示能否帮助 MLLM，以及 MLLM 对视觉 token 语义一致性的依赖程度。
AI.method: 作者首先定义语言对齐编码器 patch token 的语义一致性与不一致性，并划分出语义一致 token（SCTs）和语义不一致 token（SITs）。随后通过移除 SCTs 或 SITs 进行系统探针实验，检验现代 MLLM 的性能变化。进一步提出 SGT 训练目标，将传统语言建模损失与最小化语义不一致性的视觉引导损失结合，推动视觉编码器生成更语义一致的 token。
AI.result: 实验表明，移除 SCTs 比移除 SITs 导致更明显的性能下降，说明 MLLM 更依赖语义一致的视觉 token。SGT 在视觉中心基准上优于所有基线和配备专用视觉编码器的 MLLM，同时在文本中心任务上保持较强性能，并在所有任务平均上达到新的最优水平。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 的视觉表示不应只追求语言对齐，还需兼顾语义一致性。SGT 通过联合语言对齐与语义一致性引导，为设计更适合视觉中心任务的 MLLM 视觉编码器提供了新方向。

title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
summary: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. Existing methods treat this as a visual restoration problem, yet severely degraded text often cannot be read from local visual evidence alone. Humans instead read it by reasoning over image context, logical patterns, and prior knowledge. This raises a fundamental question: Does TAISR need reasoning? To answer this, we introduce two diagnostic tools. The first, ReasonText, is a human-curated benchmark that separates reasoning-required text from locally recoverable text. The second, Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy (GTTCA), is a recognition-based metric that measures text restoration quality without text detection errors. Evaluating twelve recent super-resolution (SR) models, we find a consistent and substantial performance drop on reasoning-required text, revealing a systematic blind spot. Two observations point to a remedy. One is that text-conditioned SR models restore text substantially better when given ground-truth text. The other is that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can read degraded text in low-resolution images through reasoning. We therefore propose Reasoning Transfer via Captioning (RTC), a training-free plug-in that uses an external MLLM to infer the degraded text and feeds the resulting caption to a text-conditioned SR model. RTC consistently improves all six text-conditioned SR models we evaluate, especially on reasoning-required text. Surprisingly, a real-world SR model with RTC can even outperform the TAISR model with RTC, suggesting that reasoning should be a core design axis for future TAISR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出文本感知超分辨率（TAISR）可能需要显式推理能力，并设计了ReasonText基准和GTTCA指标来诊断现有模型在“需要推理才能恢复的文本”上的性能缺口；随后提出免训练插件RTC，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）推断退化文本并作为条件输入，显著提升文本条件SR模型的文本恢复质量。
AI.motivation: 传统TAISR将低分辨率文本恢复视为局部视觉修复问题，但当文本严重退化时，仅依赖局部图像线索可能无法正确识别。人类会结合图像上下文、逻辑规律和先验知识进行推理式阅读。因此作者质疑：TAISR是否需要推理？并通过诊断实验验证这一假设。
AI.method: 作者提出两项诊断工具：1）ReasonText，人工构建的基准，将文本分为“需要推理恢复”和“局部视觉可恢复”两类；2）Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy（GTTCA），基于识别的文本恢复质量指标，避免文本检测误差干扰。基于此评估12种SR模型，发现它们在需要推理的文本上普遍显著下降。随后提出Reasoning Transfer via Captioning（RTC）：使用外部MLLM根据低质量图像上下文推断退化文本，生成caption，再输入给文本条件SR模型，整个流程免训练并即插即用。
AI.result: 实验显示，现有SR模型在需要推理的文本上存在系统性薄弱点；当给文本条件SR模型真实文本时，恢复效果大幅提升；MLLM能够通过推理读取低分辨率退化文本。应用RTC后，6种文本条件SR模型均获得一致提升，尤其在需要推理的文本上改善明显。此外，配备RTC的真实场景SR模型甚至可能超过配备RTC的TAISR模型，说明推理能力可能比专用TAISR结构更关键。
AI.conclusion: TAISR不应仅被看作局部像素或视觉恢复任务，而应将图像级语义推理纳入核心设计要素。MLLM提供的文本推断可作为有效推理先验，通过caption条件显著提升退化文本恢复质量。该工作呼吁未来TAISR模型把推理作为基本设计轴，并可能重新定义文本超分辨率的技术路线。

title: WaveFlow-UIE: A Single-Pipeline Wavelet-Domain Flow Model for Efficient Underwater Image Restoration
summary: Underwater image restoration remains challenging because color distortion, scattering, and detail loss affect low- and high-frequency image components differently. Recent diffusion-based methods have shown strong restoration quality, but often rely on multi-stage pipelines and costly iterative refinement. We present WaveFlow-UIE, a single-pipeline wavelet-domain flow model that directly learns to transform degraded underwater wavelet representations into clean ones. Our method applies a discrete wavelet transform, estimates lightweight physics-inspired degradation cues including transmission and ambient light, and conditions a velocity network trained with flow matching in wavelet space. The training objective combines flow-matching, frequency-weighted reconstruction, perceptual, color-consistency, and physics-consistency losses. Across UIEB, LSUI, UFO-120, and EUVP, WaveFlow-UIE achieves a strong quality-efficiency tradeoff, with especially competitive results on perceptual metrics. Relative to a strong wavelet-based diffusion baseline, the proposed model substantially reduces inference cost while maintaining or improving restoration quality on several paired benchmarks. We show that reducing the inference process from five flow steps to a single step preserves nearly all of the restoration quality while providing an additional speedup of about $4\times$ on UIEB at $256\times256$ resolution. This single-step result suggests that a single-pass wavelet-domain model is an effective alternative to heavier diffusion-style refinement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WaveFlow-UIE：一种单流程小波域流模型，用于高效水下图像复原，通过在小波空间直接学习从退化表征到清晰表征的变换，显著降低迭代式扩散模型带来的推理成本。
AI.motivation: 水下图像复原面临颜色失真、光散射和细节丢失等问题，且这些退化对低频与高频成分的影响不同。现有扩散模型复原质量较高，但常依赖多阶段流程和昂贵的迭代细化，推理开销较大，难以兼顾质量与效率。
AI.method: 该方法首先对退化水下图像进行离散小波变换，并在小波域中估计传输图和光照环境等轻量物理启发退化线索；随后训练一个条件速度网络，利用流匹配在小波空间中直接建模退化到清晰表示的连续变换。训练目标融合流匹配损失、频率加权重建损失、感知损失、颜色一致性损失和物理一致性损失，以同时优化低频整体结构与高频细节恢复。
AI.result: 在 UIEB、LSUI、UFO-120 和 EUVP 数据集上，WaveFlow-UIE 取得了较强的质量—效率权衡，尤其在感知类指标上表现突出。相对于基于小波的扩散基线，该模型在多个成对基准上显著降低推理成本，同时保持或提升复原质量。在 256×256 分辨率 UIEB 上，将推理从 5 个流步骤减少到 1 个步骤后，几乎保持全部复原质量，并带来约 4 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 单流程小波域流模型能够以较低计算开销替代更重的扩散式迭代细化，为高效高质量水下图像复原提供了一种有效方案；其中单次前向推理即可保留大部分性能，说明在小波空间中进行单次流式变换具有较强实用价值。

title: Fear of Memorizing Objects: End-to-End Zero-Shot Model-Based Object Detection
summary: This paper presents FOMO (Fear of Memorizing Objects), an end-to-end trainable transformer-based architecture for zero-shot model-based object detection. Existing approaches typically follow a proposal-and-match pipeline: target-agnostic mask proposals are generated and then matched to template features in a set of loosely coupled stages, making them susceptible to fragmented proposals in clutter and degraded matching under occlusions. FOMO elegantly replaces this paradigm by injecting object template information early in the detection pipeline: Bidirectional attention between learnable latent tokens, multi-view CAD templates, and query image features produces object-aware image features and conditioned queries which are subsequently decoded into bounding-box and confidence predictions. We train FOMO on Clutter6D, a novel large-scale synthetic dataset with over 500k images featuring more than 10k diverse object models rendered in highly cluttered scenes with multiple instances and varying occlusion levels, which addresses the limited object diversity and lack of realistic dense clutter in existing datasets for training zero-shot multi-instance algorithms. In true zero-shot fashion, FOMO achieves 54.2 mAP on BOP-Classic-Core at 0.23 s per image, ranking second overall with 3.8 pp difference to the top method while being more than 7x faster. Throughout comprehensive ablation studies we investigate and verify architectural design choices.

AI.tldr: FOMO是一种端到端可训练的Transformer架构，通过早期注入CAD模板信息实现零样本模型化目标检测，在BOP-Classic-Core上达到54.2 mAP且速度显著快于多数方法。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本目标检测方法多采用“生成候选区域再匹配模板”的流程，各阶段耦合松散，容易在复杂背景和遮挡场景下产生碎片化候选并降低匹配性能。
AI.method: FOMO利用可学习潜token、多视角CAD模板与查询图像特征之间的双向注意力，在检测流程早期融合目标模板信息，生成目标感知的图像特征和条件化查询，再由解码器直接输出边界框与置信度。
AI.result: 在真实零样本设置下，FOMO在BOP-Classic-Core上取得54.2 mAP，推理速度为每图0.23秒，总体排名第二，与最佳方法仅差3.8个百分点，但速度快7倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 端到端模板注入式检测范式能够显著提升复杂遮挡场景下零样本目标检测的鲁棒性和效率；同时，大规模合成数据集Clutter6D为训练零样本多实例检测模型提供了更丰富的多样性和密集杂波环境。

title: Real Pairs Are Not Enough: Physically Anchored Supervision for Volumetric CT Super-Resolution
summary: Volumetric CT super-resolution (SR) models are commonly trained on synthetic or physically acquired pairs of low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) volumes. However, synthetic pairs miss real acquisition effects, whereas registered physical pairs retain inter-scan noise, artifact, and microstructure differences---causing direct voxelwise regression, and even naive synthetic-real mixing, to oversmooth fine porous structures. We introduce the Physically-anchored Implicit Network (PIN) with Real-Pair Dual-Anchor learning, which decouples physical-pair supervision into two complementary roles. The HR anchor teaches fine structure from registered HR through pair-conditioned spectral replay, while the LR anchor constrains the prediction from acquired LR via affine-calibrated low-pass projection. Together with exact synthetic supervision in one shared volumetric implicit model, PIN learns from both physical scans without forcing the acquired-LR reconstruction to match registered HR voxel by voxel. Inference requires only acquired LR. Across 30 external baseline configurations on real CT, PIN achieves the lowest full-volume LPIPS, reduces average symmetric surface distance by 42.3-49.5% and bone-volume-fraction error by 52.2-53.4% relative to the three strongest baselines for each metric, and lowers the erased reference-pore volume fraction from 37.3-72.9% to 10.4%. Code, pretrained models, and evaluation scripts will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出物理锚定隐式网络 PIN 及其真实配对双锚点学习机制，将物理 CT 配对监督解耦为 HR 结构锚点与 LR 保真锚点，并结合合成精确监督，实现从低分辨率体积 CT 推理时更好地保留细小孔隙与骨微结构。实验显示其在真实 CT 上显著降低 LPIPS、表面距离误差和骨体积分数误差，并大幅减少孔隙擦除。
AI.motivation: 体素 CT 超分辨率模型通常用合成或物理采集的低分辨率—高分辨率配对训练，但合成数据缺少真实采集效应，物理配对又包含扫描间噪声、伪影和微结构差异，导致体素级直接回归甚至简单混合合成—真实数据都会使精细多孔结构被过度平滑。
AI.method: 提出 Physically-anchored Implicit Network（PIN），采用 Real-Pair Dual-Anchor learning：将物理配对监督拆成两个互补角色。HR 锚点通过配对条件谱回放学习配准 HR 中的精细结构；LR 锚点通过仿射校准低通投影约束预测与原始采集 LR 的保真度；同时在一个共享体素隐式模型中引入精确合成监督。推理阶段仅需输入采集得到的 LR 体积，无需 HR 配对。
AI.result: 在真实 CT 上覆盖 30 个外部基线配置时，PIN 取得最低的全体积 LPIPS；相对于三个最强基线，平均对称表面距离降低 42.3%—49.5%，骨体积分数误差降低 52.2%—53.4%；参考孔隙被擦除的体积分数从 37.3%—72.9% 降至 10.4%。代码、预训练模型和评测脚本将公开。
AI.conclusion: PIN 通过双锚点解耦真实配对监督，避免了强制物理 LR 与注册 HR 逐体素一致，从而在保留真实采集约束的同时增强细粒度孔隙和骨微结构重建能力，为真实医学影像超分辨率中合成与物理数据混合训练提供了可迁移的框架。

title: SCR-Mamba: Skeleton-conditioned Mamba with cross-scale incremental refinement for efficient 3D human pose estimation
summary: Mamba-based methods for video-based 3D human pose estimation can model long sequences with linear complexity, but their selective state updates usually lack direct exploitation of skeletal relations. Meanwhile, stacking modeling blocks at the full temporal resolution leads to high computational overhead, while compressing the temporal sequence makes it difficult to retain per-frame details. To address these issues, we propose SCR-Mamba, whose core consists of Skeleton-Conditioned State Modeling (SCSM) and Cross-Scale Incremental Refinement (CSIR). SCSM generates a skeleton context from bone connections and left-right symmetry relations and generates the selective parameters of the spatial and temporal branches conditioned on it, so that structural relations are involved in the writing, propagation, and reading of state information. CSIR constructs multi-scale motion representations through content-adaptive aggregation and progressively refines the retained per-frame features with the increments produced by coarse-scale modeling, integrating long-range motion context while reducing full-resolution computation. On Human3.6M with Stacked Hourglass (SH) 2D detections and 243-frame inputs, SCR-Mamba-L achieves 36.8 mm MPJPE (P1) with 7.72 M parameters and 15.10 G MACs, less than 1/7 of the computational cost of StructMamPose-L with similar accuracy; SCR-Mamba-X further reaches 36.6 mm P1 and 30.9 mm P-MPJPE (P2), achieving state-of-the-art performance. On MPI-INF-3DHP, SCR-Mamba-X achieves a percentage of correct keypoints (PCK) of 99.3%, an area under the curve (AUC) of 88.1%, and an MPJPE of 14.2 mm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCR-Mamba，用于基于视频的3D人体姿态估计。该方法通过骨架条件化状态建模和跨尺度增量精炼，在保留逐帧细节的同时显式利用骨骼拓扑与左右对称结构，并降低全时序分辨率建模的计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有Mamba方法虽能以线性复杂度建模长视频序列，但其选择性状态更新通常未直接利用人体骨骼的结构关系；同时，在全时序分辨率上堆叠建模模块计算成本高，而过度压缩时序序列又难以保留每帧的精细姿态信息。
AI.method: 提出SCR-Mamba，核心包括：1）Skeleton-Conditioned State Modeling（SCSM）：由骨骼连接关系和左右对称关系生成骨架上下文，并以此条件化空间分支与时间分支的选择性参数，使结构关系参与状态信息的写入、传播和读取；2）Cross-Scale Incremental Refinement（CSIR）：通过内容自适应聚合构建多尺度运动表示，并利用粗尺度建模产生的增量逐步精炼保留下来的逐帧特征，从而在整合长程运动上下文的同时减少全分辨率计算。
AI.result: 在Human3.6M数据集、Stacked Hourglass（SH）2D检测输入和243帧序列设置下，SCR-Mamba-L达到36.8 mm P1 MPJPE，仅包含7.72 M参数和15.10 G MACs，计算成本不足类似精度StructMamPose-L的1/7；SCR-Mamba-X进一步提升到36.6 mm P1 MPJPE和30.9 mm P2 MPJPE，取得SOTA性能。在MPI-INF-3DHP上，SCR-Mamba-X达到99.3% PCK、88.1% AUC和14.2 mm MPJPE。
AI.conclusion: SCR-Mamba通过显式引入骨架结构条件和跨尺度增量式特征精炼，有效弥补了Mamba式时序模型在结构建模与逐帧细节保留方面的不足，在3D人体姿态估计中实现了精度与计算效率之间的良好平衡。

title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对推理型视觉语言模型（VLM）中长视觉上下文和逐步增长的推理轨迹导致的 KV cache 显存压力，提出训练无关的低秩 KV 压缩框架 TraceKV。该方法通过在线策略校准、敏感度感知的 SVD 和全局秩分配，降低压缩后的策略偏移，从而在显著压缩 KV cache 的同时保持推理准确率，并提升解码速度。
AI.motivation: Reasoning vision-language models require large multimodal contexts and long reasoning traces, which substantially increase KV cache demands. Low-rank KV compression is promising and can be combined with quantization, but existing methods often cause predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning-related KV states. This drift leads to reasoning failures. The paper identifies two causes: calibration-state mismatch between static calibration contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across different KV states.
AI.method: The paper proposes TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework designed to preserve model behavior during reasoning. Its key components include: (1) on-policy calibration, which aligns the compression calibration distribution with actual reasoning-time KV states rather than static contexts; (2) sensitivity-aware SVD, which performs low-rank decomposition according to the unequal error sensitivity of different KV states; and (3) global rank allocation, which assigns rank budgets across KV states under a unified policy-preserving principle to minimize policy-KL divergence. The framework can also be combined with quantization for additional compression. Optimized low-rank attention kernels are implemented to improve practical decoding efficiency.
AI.result: Experiments across multiple vision-language models and visual reasoning benchmarks show that TraceKV achieves better accuracy-memory trade-offs than existing low-rank KV compression methods. When combined with quantization, it reaches near-lossless reasoning accuracy while achieving 5.64x KV cache compression. With optimized low-rank attention kernels, it delivers up to 1.83x end-to-end decoding speedup.
AI.conclusion: TraceKV addresses a key failure mode of low-rank KV compression for reasoning VLMs: growing policy drift during autoregressive reasoning. By integrating on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware decomposition, and global rank allocation under a policy-preserving objective, it can substantially reduce reasoning accuracy degradation while achieving high compression and practical speedup. The method is training-free and compatible with quantization, making it a promising approach for efficient long-context visual reasoning deployment.

title: RipBench: A Unified Benchmark for Multi-Level Rip Current Detection, Classification and Segmentation
summary: Rip currents are a serious and often under-addressed threat to beach safety and the leading cause of coastal drownings worldwide. They are difficult to detect due to their amorphous structure, similarity to the background, and large variability in viewpoints and environments. Despite their dangers and growing interest in automated detection, existing research remains fragmented across datasets, metrics, models, and approaches, leading to an incomplete understanding of model performance. We introduce RipBench, a unified benchmark that enables controlled evaluation of rip current detection spanning multiple tasks, including classification, axis-aligned and oriented object detection, and instance, semantic, and panoptic segmentation, on the same data with standardized splits. This allows direct comparison of model performance on all levels of visual abstraction. Across $304$ videos ($303{,}491$ frames, $51{,}011$ of them annotated for all six tasks) collected from diverse coastlines, our results expose a clear performance gap between coarse recognition and precise spatial understanding: frame-level classification reaches $F_2 = 0.93$, while the best detector and the best instance segmenter reach $0.72$ and $0.66$, with model rankings that change from task to task. Video-level confidence intervals, a blind inter-annotator study of the spatial labels, stratified analyses by viewpoint and visual signature, and video views with temporal baselines (single-seed, short-schedule reference runs) accompany the benchmark. All tasks are supported with carefully curated annotations and evaluated using standard metrics, with a focus on the $F_2$ score to emphasize recall in this safety-critical setting. RipBench, along with multiple baselines per task, is publicly available at this https URL to support progress in real-world, multi-task vision for beach safety.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. 47 pages, 11 figures. See this https URL for dataset and project updates

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RipBench：一个面向离岸流检测的统一多任务视频基准，覆盖分类、边界框与方向框检测、实例/语义/全景分割，并在同一数据和标准化切分下评估模型性能。
AI.motivation: 离岸流是全球海岸溺水的主要原因，但其外观无明显结构、与背景相似且视角与环境变化大，自动检测研究又分散于不同数据集、指标和任务设置中，导致难以系统理解模型真实性能。
AI.method: 作者构建包含 304 段视频、303,491 帧的统一数据集，其中 51,011 帧针对六类视觉任务进行完整标注；在同一数据上建立标准化训练/测试划分，使用标准指标尤其侧重召回的 F2 分数进行评估，并辅以视频级置信区间、标注一致性研究、视角/视觉特征分层分析，以及基于时间基线的单随机种子、短训练调度参考视频结果。
AI.result: 结果显示粗略识别与精细空间理解之间存在明显性能差距：帧级分类可达 F2=0.93，而最佳目标检测器和最佳实例分割器分别仅达 0.72 和 0.66；不同任务中的模型排名也会变化。
AI.conclusion: RipBench 为离岸流检测提供了统一、可控、可比较的多任务评估平台，揭示了当前模型在精细空间理解上的不足，并为面向海滩安全的真实世界视觉研究提供了公开数据、标注、基线和评测协议。

title: FoveaDet: Software-Hardware Co-Design of Foveated CNN-Transformer for Object Detection
summary: Deploying real-time object detection on power-constrained edge platforms is challenging as processing full-resolution frames is often computationally redundant. Inspired by biological foveation which assigns variable resolution based on visual saliency, we propose a novel software-hardware co-design framework called FoveaDet. On the software side, FoveaDet dynamically identifies salient regions to predict fixation points, followed by aggressive patch pruning in Vision Transformers (ViT) to discard irrelevant background data. To mitigate slowdowns from sequential patch generation, we implement optimized interpolation and patch selection algorithms. Evaluated on standard GPUs, this foveated approach reduces floating-point operations by 65.4% to 92.2% and accelerates inference by 4.76x, while suffering a negligible mAP drop compared to dense baselines. To eliminate hardware bottlenecks, we complement the algorithm with a custom RISC-V core featuring specialized instructions to accelerate the foveated processing pipeline. FoveaDet provides a scalable, efficient architecture capable of unlocking advanced vision processing on severely constrained mobile platforms.
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027

AI.tldr: 论文提出 FoveaDet，一种软硬件协同设计框架，通过生物启发的注视点式变分辨率视觉处理和硬件加速，在受限边缘平台上实现高效实时目标检测，同时保持近乎无损的 mAP。
AI.motivation: 在功耗受限的边缘平台部署实时目标检测时，处理全分辨率图像会造成大量计算冗余；现有方法难以在显著区域聚焦、背景裁剪与硬件执行效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: FoveaDet 在软件端动态识别视觉显著区域并预测注视点，随后在 Vision Transformer 中对无关背景 patch 进行激进裁剪，并设计优化的插值与 patch 选择算法以降低顺序生成延迟；在硬件端引入定制 RISC-V 核和专用指令加速整个注视化处理流程。
AI.result: 在标准 GPU 上评估显示，该方法可减少 65.4% 到 92.2% 的浮点运算，并实现 4.76 倍推理加速，同时相比密集基线仅有可忽略的 mAP 下降；结合 RISC-V 专用硬件后进一步缓解硬件瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: FoveaDet 提供了可扩展且高效的架构，通过显著性驱动的变分辨率处理、ViT patch 裁剪与指令级硬件加速相结合，使资源严重受限的移动边缘平台也能运行先进视觉检测任务。

title: Cat Royale Comprehensive Dataset: A Dataset for Pose Detection, Segmentation, Animal Action Recognition and Scene Understanding
summary: Animal focused computer vision datasets are of a growing interest in the fields of both Computer Vision and Animal behaviour. The ability to make sense of complex scenes via a variety of Computer Vision tasks has substantial implications for behavioural understanding and welfare. The perfection of these tasks will help lead to better health and emotional outcomes for wild and domestic animals. In this work we present the Cat Royale Comprehensive Dataset (CRCD), a large, comprehensive, multi-modal dataset for feline understanding, based on a huge database of over 500 hours of video captured during the Cat Royale artwork and research project. Our dataset contains annotations for a range of computer vision problems including 20,000 images with instance segmentation masks, 5000 images with multi-subject pose coordinates, over 800 video clips with action classes, and over 800 clips with detailed text description. This is the first such dataset to link this wide range of annotation types together for multi-modal use. We release this entire dataset, and our custom annotation tools will also be made available, in order to allow for ongoing expansion. We also provide a series of benchmarks for the tasks of Instance Segmentation, Pose detection, Temporal Action Localisation, and finally video-text retrieval. The totality of this multi-modal dataset is the data needed to solve both these individual computer vision tasks as well as enabling more complex multi-modal tasks making use of a combination of annotations.
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Computer Vision. Dataset: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该工作提出 Cat Royale Comprehensive Dataset（CRCD），一个面向猫理解的大规模多模态数据集，整合实例分割、姿态估计、动作识别/定位、视频文本描述等标注，并提供多个任务基准。
AI.motivation: 动物导向的计算机视觉数据集对理解复杂场景、动物行为以及改善野生与家养动物健康和福利具有重要意义，但现有动物数据集在跨任务标注和多模态整合方面不足。作者希望构建一个能够支持多种基础计算机视觉任务及更复杂多模态任务的综合性猫数据集。
AI.method: 作者基于 Cat Royale 艺术与研究项目获得的超过 500 小时视频数据库，构建 CRCD 数据集，并对其进行多类型标注：包括 20,000 张带有实例分割掩码的图像、5000 张带有多个主体姿态坐标的图像、800 多个带有动作类别的视频片段，以及 800 多个带有详细文本描述的视频片段。此外，作者发布数据集和自定义标注工具，并针对实例分割、姿态检测、时序动作定位以及视频文本检索建立基准。
AI.result: CRCD 成为首个将实例分割、多主体姿态、动作标注和文本描述等多种标注类型统一链接的猫理解多模态数据集。所发布的基准覆盖单模态感知任务和跨模态检索任务，为该领域后续研究提供数据、工具和评测基础。
AI.conclusion: CRCD 通过大规模、多模态、多任务标注的整合，支持基础猫行为与视觉理解任务，并为复杂多模态研究和持续数据集扩展提供基础设施。

title: CoCode-World: Shared 3D Proxy Representation for Multi-Player World Models
summary: Multiplayer generative world models must produce observations that agree on shared entities despite different camera motions and occlusions. Explicit world representations provide spatial control, but precise modeling of individual game maps limits scene diversity, while shared geometry alone cannot ensure consistent appearance across views. We present CoCode-World, a shared 3D proxy framework that separates structural control from visual synthesis for two-player video generation. Programmable proxies specify scene layout, motion, and occlusion, while RGB references guide character and scene appearance. To coordinate visual details across players, we concatenate paired proxy videos, appearance references, and target views in a consistent spatial layout and generate both views jointly with a pretrained video model. This formulation uses the model's native attention for cross-view communication within a single generation branch, with LoRA adaptation learning proxy adherence and appearance correspondence from paired observations. We construct a two-player GTA~V dataset that pairs synchronized RGB observations with proxy videos derived from shared map geometry and game-engine state. Experiments demonstrate appearance transfer to characters and scene styles unseen during training, with improvements in video quality and cross-view player identity over the evaluated baseline. Ablations further examine how proxy construction and cross-view communication affect generation. Project page: this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoCode-World，一种面向双玩家视频生成的共享 3D 代理框架，通过可编程 3D proxy 分离空间结构控制与视觉合成，并利用预训练视频模型在同一生成分支中联合生成两个玩家视角。
AI.motivation: 多玩家生成式世界模型需要在不同相机运动、可见范围与遮挡条件下保持共享场景实体的一致性。显式世界表示可提供空间控制，但过于依赖精确游戏地图会限制场景多样性；仅依靠共享几何也无法保证跨视角的外观一致性。
AI.method: CoCode-World 将任务分解为结构控制和视觉合成两部分。可编程 3D proxy 用于指定场景布局、运动和遮挡关系，RGB reference 用于提供角色与场景外观线索。作者将配对的 proxy videos、appearance references 和目标视图按统一空间布局拼接，输入预训练视频模型进行双视角联合生成。该方法利用模型原生 attention 实现单分支内的跨视角通信，并通过 LoRA 微调学习 proxy 遵循能力与外观对应关系。实验还构建了两玩家 GTA V 数据集，将同步 RGB 观测与由共享地图几何和游戏引擎状态导出的 proxy videos 配对。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够将外观迁移到训练时未见的角色和场景风格，并在视频质量和跨视角玩家身份一致性方面优于所评估基线。消融实验进一步验证了 proxy 构建方式和跨视角通信机制对生成效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: CoCode-World 通过共享 3D proxy 实现了结构控制与外观合成的解耦，为多玩家视频生成提供了跨视角一致性建模方案，表明在单一生成分支中进行联合视角建模是提升共享实体外观和身份稳定性的有效路径。

title: Learning-Based Interpolation of Detector Gaps in Photon-Counting X-ray Imaging
summary: Image detectors assembled from tiled modules have physical gaps in the field of view that must be filled before downstream processing such as phase retrieval or tomographic reconstruction. Unlike natural-image inpainting, detector-gap interpolation must leave all other pixels unmodified and preserve the intensity statistics of the filled region, since even a small shift in mean intensity can cause ring artifacts after reconstruction. We adapted two generative models, a Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty (WGAN-GP) and a conditional Pix2Pix model, to this task. We implemented a masking strategy that restricts all changes to the gap pixels and loss terms that constrain the mean intensity and the intensity distribution of the filled region. Both models were trained on nanoCT projections with simulated gaps and compared with linear interpolation, Navier--Stokes inpainting, and the deep image-inpainting network MADF, quantitatively on simulated gaps and visually on real detector gaps. WGAN-GP and Pix2Pix achieved the best perceptual similarity (LPIPS) and histogram distance and, apart from linear interpolation, the shortest inference time. Pix2Pix required about five times fewer training GPU-hours than WGAN-GP. Ablation studies showed that masking the network output contributes by far the most to plausible inpainting results. Applied to sinograms, Pix2Pix produced the most natural gap filling but improved the reconstruction only slightly compared with linear interpolation. The source code and the weights of the final Pix2Pix model are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对探测器拼接产生的物理缝隙填补任务，改进并比较了WGAN-GP和Pix2Pix两类生成模型，通过输出掩码和强度统计约束，使填缝仅修改缝隙像素并保持投影强度分布；实验表明其感知质量和直方图匹配最优，但相比线性插值对最终重构质量提升有限。
AI.motivation: tiled探测器在视场中存在物理间隙，需在相位恢复或层析重构前进行填补。与自然图像修复不同，探测器缝隙填补必须不改变其他像素，并保持填补区域的强度统计，因为平均强度的微小偏移会在重构中引入环状伪影。
AI.method: 作者将WGAN-GP与条件Pix2Pix模型适配到探测器缝隙填补任务中，并设计掩码策略限制网络只修改缝隙像素，同时加入约束平均强度和强度分布的损失项。模型在带模拟缝隙的nanoCT投影数据上训练，并与线性插值、Navier-Stokes修复和MADF网络在模拟缝隙上定量比较，在真实探测器缝隙上进行视觉比较。
AI.result: WGAN-GP和Pix2Pix在感知相似度LPIPS和直方图距离方面表现最佳，除线性插值外推理时间也最短；Pix2Pix训练所需GPU小时数约为WGAN-GP的五分之一。消融实验表明，对网络输出进行掩码处理是获得合理修复效果的最关键因素。将该方法应用于正弦图时，Pix2Pix能产生最自然的缝隙填充效果，但相比线性插值仅轻微改善最终重构结果。
AI.conclusion: 对于探测器缝隙填补，强制仅修改缝隙像素并约束强度分布比单纯追求修复纹理更关键；Pix2Pix因训练效率更高且感知效果好，更适合作为实用的缝隙填补方案，但在下游重构指标上相对简单线性插值的优势有限。

title: WaveletLoRA: Frequency-Aware Content-Style Decomposition for Personalized Image Generation
summary: Content-style decomposition from a single image is a fundamental challenge in personalized image generation, aiming to separate subject identity from visual style for flexible recomposition. Existing approaches primarily operate in the spatial domain, without explicitly exploiting the distinct frequency characteristics naturally associated with content and style. In this paper, we propose WaveletLoRA, a novel frequency-aware framework for explicit content-style decomposition through wavelet-domain supervision.
