AI.tldr: 该论文提出STeP-C，一种面向分布式光纤声学传感DAS连续数据流的神经压缩框架，在真实流式采集系统中实现高压缩比、高保真和满足实时吞吐要求的端到端部署。
AI.motivation: DAS等分布式光纤传感会持续产生数百MB/s的高分辨率时空数据，给实时存储和传输带来巨大压力。已有神经压缩方法虽在率失真性能上表现较好，但通常需要逐段重训练、只适用于离线处理，或未能在大规模持续流式DAS采集系统中端到端验证。作者进一步发现，熵编码是流式部署的主要瓶颈，因此需要从模型结构和系统工程两方面解决实时压缩问题。
AI.method: 论文提出STeP-C，即时空预测压缩框架。其核心思想是将压缩流程解耦为空间编码、时序预测和熵优化残差编码三个部分，并以面向条件熵下降的率失真目标进行端到端训练。针对实时流式部署，作者围绕GPU设计完整管线：包括GPU侧符号计算、缓存概率表、无GIL的并行算术编码、FP16推理、批量熵编码以及GPU环形缓冲区。该设计旨在同时保证压缩质量、系统吞吐和持续流处理能力。
AI.result: 在真实DAS测试平台上，STeP-C实现了98.85%的文件大小降低，在全频带PSNR达到31.04 dB，平均吞吐为535 MB/s，高于1 kHz、81 km DAS数据流所需的324 MB/s实时阈值。实验还表明，该方法在实用流式码率下显著优于传统编码器，并且能够在同一采集系统中迁移到未见过的通道范围而无需重训练。同时，其对下游检测任务的语义一致性保持较好，高置信度类别一致率达到96.62%，检测事件类型的Jaccard相似度为100%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了神经压缩可以在真实、大规模、持续流式DAS系统中端到端落地，实现高压缩比、高质量重建和满足实时性要求的吞吐。论文的关键贡献不仅是提出STeP-C框架，还在于识别并解决熵编码这一流式部署瓶颈，为DAS等高速光纤传感数据的实时压缩、存储和传输提供了可行方案。

title: HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
summary: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HiVE-VQA，一种基于冻结视频基础模型 V-JEPA 2.1 的无参考视频质量评估（NR-VQA）框架；通过从编码器不同深度提取 token 特征并构建分层时空体，仅使用 5.2M 参数的 3D 卷积头即可在多个基准上超越 17 种 SOTA 方法。
AI.motivation: 用户生成视频激增，使准确且鲁棒的 NR-VQA 变得重要。现有方法常依赖复杂的多分支架构或对单分支主干进行高成本微调，存在效率与泛化不足的问题。作者希望探究：单一冻结的视频基础模型能否成为高效且有效的 NR-VQA 主干。
AI.method: HiVE-VQA 以预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 视频编码器作为冻结主干，从多个网络深度提取 token grid，并将它们堆叠为分层时空体；随后用一个紧凑 3D 卷积头在层维度、空间维度和时间维度上进行融合，以结合浅层低层失真线索与深层语义及时序上下文。训练时仅更新 3D 头，共 5.2M 参数，占总量 5.7%，不依赖辅助多模态模型；推理开销不随视频分辨率变化。模型仅在 LSVQ 上训练，并在测试阶段不进行额外微调。

AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，任务专用多网络融合并非 NR-VQA 的最佳路线；对单一冻结视频基础模型进行分层、跨深度的特征融合可显著提升效率与有效性。HiVE-VQA 为使用 JEPA 类视频基础模型进行无参考视频质量评估提供了新的范式。

title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
summary: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph. We investigate whether labelled validation data can improve a frozen-parameter vision-language evaluator through prompt selection rather than model fine-tuning. Version~1 generates 50 candidate prompts and selects the top-ranked instruction using a security-oriented loss that prioritises missed morph attacks (MACER) while accounting for bona fide classification errors (BSCER), response failures, parse failures, and decision inconsistency. Version~2 recursively revises prompts using aggregate validation feedback. On a subject-disjoint test set of 160 pairs spanning LMA, MIPGAN-2, and PIPE, the selected Version~1 prompt achieves a (19.17\%) morph attack classification error rate (MACER), with (0.00\%) observed bona fide sample classification error rate (BSCER), compared with (70.00\%) MACER for a controlled manual prompt. The paired (50.83) percentage-point difference has a (95\%) subject-bootstrap interval of ([43.33,58.33]). Recursive revision does not surpass the best Generation~0 validation loss; the reported revised descendant obtains (31.67\%) test MACER. All 23 attacks missed by Version~1 are landmark-based (LMA) morphs. Overall, the results show that prompt formulation can substantially influence frozen-parameter VLM-based D-MAD performance, while also highlighting the challenge of recursive prompt refinement under a compact 10-subject validation setting.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察在不微调模型参数的条件下，是否可通过利用带标签验证数据进行提示词选择来提升冻结参数视觉语言模型用于差分形态攻击检测的性能。实验表明，提示词设计对MACER影响显著，但递归修订提示词在较小验证集上难以超越初始候选提示词。
AI.motivation: 差分形态攻击检测用于比较可信活体采集与可能包含人脸形态化的证件图像。现有视觉语言模型可能具备一定判别能力，但其性能高度依赖输入提示。研究关注如何通过验证反馈和安全性导向损失选择或修订提示词，而非依赖模型微调，以提高冻结参数VLM在D-MAD任务中的检测效果。
AI.method: 提出两种提示词优化流程。Version 1生成50个候选提示词，并使用安全性导向验证损失进行排序；该损失重点关注漏检形态攻击的MACER，同时纳入良态样本误分类BSCER、响应失败、解析失败和决策不一致。Version 2利用聚合验证反馈递归修订提示词。评测采用受试者不相交测试集，共160对图像，涵盖LMA、MIPGAN-2和PIPE三类形态攻击，并与受控手工提示词进行比较。
AI.result: Version 1所选提示词在测试集上取得19.17%的MACER和0.00%的BSCER；相比之下，手工提示词的MACER为70.00%。两者配对的50.83个百分点差异具有95%受试者bootstrap置信区间[43.33,58.33]。Version 2的递归修订未超越最佳Generation 0验证损失，其修订后提示词在测试集上的MACER为31.67%。Version 1漏检的23个攻击样本全部为基于关键点的LMA形态攻击。
AI.conclusion: 提示词构建可显著影响冻结参数VLM在D-MAD任务中的性能，尤其在降低形态攻击漏检率方面具有较大潜力。然而，在仅包含10名受试者验证数据的紧凑设置下，递归提示词修订容易过拟合或泛化不足，难以稳定提升测试性能。

title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
summary: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. A two-part benchmark measures it and the object masking meant to prevent it. A static protocol scores ten pipelines under exactly known homographies on 4K aerial frames, tuned on a site-disjoint split at a matched resolution and feature budget. A dynamic protocol scores them at an offline and a real-time budget on hovers selected from the video alone to span the amount and coherence of moving foreground, plus a stationary control. It measures background alignment, object position error and the share of a moving group's displacement an estimate follows, against a pseudo-ground-truth reference audited with manually annotated ground control points, which also score every candidate. On static scenes, tuned AKAZE, RootSIFT, SIFT and BRISK lead, retuning the matcher thresholds raises the mean average accuracy (mAA) by at most 0.0062, and masking costs less than 0.005. Unmasked ORB is captured on 28 of 304 real-time dynamic pairs and on 6 offline; its real-time captured estimates have a median corner error of 18.8 px yet typical inlier counts and ratios. Masking removes capture for every pipeline and leaves the leading pipelines unchanged. Code, data and results are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向无人机悬停视频参考帧配准的两阶段基准，重点评估运动前景导致的“共识捕获”问题：鲁棒单应估计可能被车辆等移动物体的致密对应关系拉偏。实验表明，前景掩膜能基本消除捕获，且对静态场景中较优配准方法的影响很小。
AI.motivation: 传统特征匹配基准通常只模拟相机运动，而真实航拍视频中会有运动物体。若多辆车辆一起运动并产生大量一致匹配，鲁棒估计可能将这些移动物体误认为背景平面，导致整帧配准被前景运动“捕获”。这种失败难以通过常规内点数量和比例发现。
AI.method: 作者设计静态和动态两套评测协议。静态协议在4K航拍帧上用已知单应矩阵评估十种配准流水线，并在站点不相交的数据划分上以相同分辨率和特征预算调优。动态协议从视频中选取覆盖不同移动前景数量与一致性的悬停片段，设置离线和实时预算，并以人工地控点审计的伪地面真值评估背景对齐、目标位置误差，以及估计结果跟随移动物体群体位移的比例。
AI.result: 静态场景中，调优后的AKAZE、RootSIFT、SIFT和BRIFT/BRISK等方法表现领先；进一步调整匹配器阈值最多将平均精度mAA提升0.0062，掩膜代价小于0.005。动态场景中，未掩膜的ORB在28/304个实时配对和6个离线配对中被捕获，其捕获估计的中位角点误差为18.8像素，但内点数量和比例仍看似正常。加入前景掩膜后，各流水线均不再出现捕获，且领先方法性能基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 共识捕获是仅靠内点统计难以识别的实际风险，尤其在包含移动车辆的航拍场景中。前景掩膜是一种有效防御手段，可在不显著损害静态配准性能的情况下消除动态捕获问题，论文同时发布了代码、数据和结果。

title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
summary: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the student toward the teacher. In multi-step distillation, although only the student's final output is delivered, existing methods train the fake model on intermediate states or across all denoising steps. Consequently, the student's update signal becomes entangled with intermediate distributions, which can distort the matching direction and remain nonzero even after the student's final outputs already match the teacher distribution. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation (eDMD), which trains a single shared fake model exclusively on the student's final outputs and uses it to correct every denoising step. Our theoretical analysis proves that this endpoint reference guarantees that the distribution matching term vanishes if and only if the student's final output distribution matches the teacher's, regardless of intermediate distributions. Beyond the fake reference, we further strengthen teacher supervision through a precise teacher (PT) that replaces single-step guided predictions with short multi-step trajectories on the final noise interval, paired with a calibrated query density for intermediate steps. Experiments on SD3-Medium, FLUX.2-klein (4B and 9B), and Qwen-Image-2.1 demonstrate that eDMD consistently outperforms existing distribution matching methods for 4-step generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出端点分布匹配蒸馏（eDMD），通过仅在扩散模型少步学生模型的最终输出上训练共享假分数模型，并使用端点匹配信号纠正所有去噪步骤，从而避免中间状态干扰蒸馏优化方向，提升4步生成质量。
AI.motivation: 分布匹配蒸馏通常用辅助假模型追踪学生分布，并以教师与假模型的预测差异驱动学生逼近教师。但在多步蒸馏中，学生最终输出才是目标，现有方法却让假模型在中间状态或所有去噪步骤上训练，导致更新信号与中间分布纠缠，可能扭曲匹配方向，即在学生最终输出已匹配教师后仍产生非零梯度。
AI.method: 作者提出Endpoint Distribution Matching Distillation，简称eDMD：训练一个共享假分数模型，仅在学生的最终输出上学习学生分布，并用该端点参考信号修正每个去噪步骤。理论上证明，只有当学生最终输出分布与教师分布一致时，端点分布匹配项才为零，与中间分布无关。此外，引入精确教师监督，将单步引导预测替换为最终噪声区间上的短程多步轨迹，并为中间步骤配置校准的查询密度，增强教师指导。
AI.result: 在SD3-Medium、FLUX.2-klein（4B和9B）以及Qwen-Image-2.1等模型上的实验表明，eDMD在4步生成任务中持续优于现有分布匹配蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示并解决了多步蒸馏中假模型训练目标与最终输出目标不一致的问题，端点-only的分布匹配能够提供更准确、更稳定的学生更新信号，结合精确教师监督后可有效提升少步扩散模型的生成质量。

title: Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
summary: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding. While recent work shows that pretrained Vision Transformers (ViTs) intrinsically acquire this ability, how native self-attention computations mechanistically keep object instances separate remains unresolved. By studying this across eight pretrained ViTs, we found that instance separation is expressed more strongly in attention routing than in token content: selected query-key relations distinguish individual objects more reliably than value similarity or residual representations. Inside heads, patches belonging to one individual tend to read from a common image region, which we term their attention address. Visually distinct parts of one person share an address, whereas identical duplicated instances receive separate, movable addresses. These shared destinations arise in part because query interactions with the spatial structure of keys direct attention toward consistent regions for one object and elsewhere for another. In DINOv2 and most other backbones we tested, editing this query component at the selected head redirects its attention address toward another individual. Grouping patches by this query component separates same-category instances, reaching .615 FG-ARI versus .289 for the same clustering of final-layer features, which tend to merge them.

AI.tldr: 论文研究预训练视觉Transformer（ViT）如何通过原生自注意力机制实现“对象绑定”：同一实例内的图像块倾向于共享一个“注意力地址”，从而在不同对象实例之间形成清晰的实例分离。
AI.motivation: 认知科学中的对象绑定指人类将视觉场景解析为连贯个体而非离散特征。近期研究发现预训练ViT内在地具备这种能力，但其原生自注意力计算在机制上如何保持不同实例彼此分离仍不清楚。
AI.method: 作者在8个预训练ViT中分析注意力头的内部结构，比较query-key注意力路由、value相似性和残差表征对实例区分的贡献；将同一对象内图像块共同读取到的图像区域定义为“attention address”；进一步通过编辑选定注意力头中的query分量来测试其能否重定向注意力地址，并使用query分量对图像块聚类，与最终层特征聚类的FG-ARI进行比较。
AI.result: 实例分离信号在attention routing中比在token content中更强：被选中的query-key关系比value相似性或残差表征更能可靠地区分不同对象。同一视觉对象的不同区域倾向于共享一个注意力地址，而重复出现的相同实例会被赋予独立且可移动的注意力地址。在DINOv2及多数测试骨干网络中，编辑选定注意力头的query分量可将其注意力地址重定向到另一对象。基于该query分量的聚类能够更好地区分同类实例，FG-ARI达到0.615，而最终层特征聚类仅为0.289且容易将实例合并。
AI.conclusion: 预训练ViT中的对象绑定主要由自注意力中的query-key路由机制实现，query与key的空间结构交互为同一实例产生共享注意力地址，并可在不同实例间保持分离。该机制不仅解释了ViT如何维持实例边界，也为通过编辑query分量控制和重定位对象归属提供了可解释、可干预的路径。

title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
summary: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.
comment: ECCV 2026. Project Website: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 vid2vid-long，一种基于图像块对应关系的交互式视频到视频生成方法，通过从历史输出中检索并条件化对应区域，显著增强长程时间一致性，同时保持实时性能。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式视频到视频生成方法为追求实时性，常将注意力限制在固定长度的因果窗口内。当相关历史帧落在该上下文窗口之外时，模型难以维持长程时间一致性，导致输出视频在时间上出现不连贯或漂移。
AI.method: 方法核心是利用视频到视频翻译中的天然跨帧对应关系：输入视频中匹配的区域，在输出视频中也应匹配。具体而言，方法在输入视频上计算图像块级别的对应关系，据此检索此前已生成的输出视频中相应区域的 patches，并通过对应关系交叉注意力（correspondence cross-attention）将这些历史 patches 作为条件输入当前生成过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，vid2vid-long 在多个近期视频模型上持续提升了长程时间一致性，同时保持了生成质量与实时生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式利用输入视频中的对应关系来检索和约束历史输出 patches，vid2vid-long 突破了固定因果窗口的长程一致性瓶颈，为实时交互式视频生成提供了一种有效且可扩展的机制。

title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment. Images alone leave these relationships implicit, while disconnected annotations make it difficult to study appearance, camera motion, and scene changes under a common reference. We introduce Spatial Foundry, a collection of 5,280 furnished residential 3D scene configurations with editable assets and aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data. Its modalities include floor plans, perspective and panoramic RGB, metric depth, point clouds, meshes, instance-level 3D bounding boxes, and camera trajectories paired with video. Shared scene coordinates link observations across views and time; editable source scenes enable additional camera paths and controlled object changes. We describe the data representation and construction workflow, and discuss applications in floor-plan-conditioned 3D generation, geometric reconstruction, instance-level perception, camera-conditioned video generation, shared world modeling, and scene editing. Controlled camera and scene variations support spatial perception and world-model research. The public project page provides videos and an interactive colored point-cloud preview.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Spatial Foundry：一个面向空间智能的住宅场景 3D 多模态数据集，包含 5,280 个可编辑的带家具室内场景，并提供对齐的视觉、几何与时间信息，支持空间感知、三维重建、视频生成与世界建模等研究。
AI.motivation: 空间智能要求将视觉观察与环境几何、物体和持久状态联系起来。仅有图像会使这些关系变得隐式，而彼此割裂的标注数据又难以在统一参照系下研究外观、相机运动和场景变化之间的关系。
AI.method: 作者构建 Spatial Foundry，包含 5,280 个住宅室内 3D 场景配置，并提供可编辑资产。数据涵盖平面图、透视与全景 RGB、米制深度、点云、网格、实例级 3D 边界框、相机轨迹以及配套视频等模态。通过共享场景坐标，将不同视角和时间下的观察统一关联；利用可编辑源场景，进一步生成新的相机路径和可控物体变化，以支持受控实验。
AI.result: 该数据集为空间智能研究提供了统一的多模态基础资源，可应用于平面图条件 3D 生成、几何重建、实例级感知、相机条件视频生成、共享世界建模和场景编辑。受控的相机与场景变化有助于空间感知和世界模型研究，公开项目页面还提供视频和交互式彩色点云预览。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Foundry 通过可编辑、多模态、具有共享坐标的住宅场景数据，弥合了视觉观察、几何结构与动态变化之间的表示差距，为空间智能、场景理解和世界建模研究提供了基础平台。

title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
summary: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文针对“给定一组 LEGO 零件和一张组装成品图像，推断每个零件的位姿以完成组装”的任务，提出先通过程序化装配数据训练集合条件 SE(3) 流模型学习零件连接先验，再通过少量数据微调注入图像条件，并在测试时使用解析连通性场引导来增强组装结构的连通性与构建质量。
AI.motivation: 传统 3D 重建通常关注连续几何恢复，而 LEGO 组装还要求满足离散物理约束，例如零件之间的正确连接、对齐与互锁关系。这些约束为问题提供了结构，但也使其具有组合复杂性，并对零件位姿的小误差非常敏感。因此，需要学习一种能够捕捉“零件如何相互连接”的先验，并将视觉信息注入该先验，以支持从图像恢复可组装的结构。
AI.method: 作者首先构造程序化生成的 LEGO 装配数据集，并训练一个集合条件 SE(3) 流模型，用于对零件位姿分布进行建模。随后，仅使用约 1% 的数据量对该模型进行微调，以引入图像条件，使模型能够根据成品图像推断零件位姿。由于学习到的流模型主要捕捉全局结构，但不显式保证装配连通性，作者进一步提出一种解析连通性场引导方法，在测试阶段将预测结果推向满足连通约束的装配配置。
AI.result: 实验表明，随着模型规模增大、预训练充分以及引入连通性场引导，组装质量得到提升。方法能够在学习零件组合先验的同时兼顾图像条件，并在测试阶段通过显式连通性约束改善最终装配的结构合理性与构建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明，将基于流模型的生成先验、少量图像条件微调以及解析物理约束引导相结合，可以有效提升由图像驱动的零件位姿估计与可组装性预测。其核心贡献在于把离散连接约束作为测试时引导引入 SE(3) 生成模型，从而改善面向实体装配任务的预测质量。

title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
summary: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion this http URL propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.

AI.tldr: 提出将视频生成中的物理推理任务从扩散模型中分离，交给基于语言模型的关键帧生成模块，并让视频扩散模型仅负责在物理正确的关键帧之间插值，从而显著降低物理错误并提升基准表现。
AI.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型能生成高质量外观和纹理，但常常出现显著物理错误，原因是在经典视频生成设置中，所有物理推理都被压缩到扩散模型中同时完成，学习负担过重。
AI.method: 采用分阶段生成框架：先用语言模型驱动的关键帧生成模块完成显式物理推理，并在视频重要时刻生成可控关键帧；再以这些关键帧作为条件，驱动视频扩散模型进行中间状态插值生成。这样把扩散模型的角色简化为“连接物理正确的中间状态”。
AI.result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified 和 PhyGenBench 两个物理合理性基准上显著优于现有方法，达到当前最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 将物理推理从像素级生成中解耦到语言模型关键帧生成中，是提升视频生成物理一致性的有效路径。

title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
summary: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: this https URL
comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Spotlight). Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Test-Time Baking (TTB)，将多视角注意力中的全局场景信息“烘焙”进轻量 MLP，实现接近最优质量的高效新视角渲染，较 SOTA 解码器式 LVSM 达到最高 23 倍加速。
AI.motivation: Decoder-only LVSM 虽质量高但依赖 KV-cache/跨视角注意力，推理计算重；TTT 层虽高效但可能损失渲染质量。需要同时获得高保真新视角合成与测试时低开销解码。
AI.method: 核心有两个：一是将 TTT 的快速权重 MLP 改为显式学习跨视角注意力的输入-输出映射，而非完全替代注意力；二是将上下文 token 解耦为仅含相机的上下文渲染 token 作为 TTB 输入，以及含图像内容的上下文真值 token 作为 TTB 映射目标，缓解上下文预填充与新视角渲染之间的模态错配。
AI.result: 在多个基准上，TTB 取得最高 23 倍渲染加速，同时渲染质量与当前最先进方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过把全局跨视角信息蒸馏/烘焙到轻量 MLP，并解耦相机与图像内容上下文，TTB 能兼顾新视角合成的速度与质量，为 LVSM 的高效测试时推理提供了可行方案。

title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
summary: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.

AI.tldr: 论文在受控计算预算下拆解多模态语言模型视觉编码器的三类设计选择，发现关键不是视觉预训练先验或预融合位置，而是与主干联合训练的专用视觉容量，并建议尽早置于融合阶段内部。
AI.motivation: 现有模型在数据、架构和算力上差异大，难以判断视觉编码器收益究竟来自预训练视觉先验、独立视觉容量，还是位于多模态融合之前的设计位置。
AI.method: 提出受控实验框架，在所有模型从零预训练、使用相同数据并匹配总算力的条件下，比较预训练视觉编码器、联合训练编码器、无编码器模型，以及在主干早期层内插入视觉专用模块等方案，并在视觉问答和语言基准上评估。
AI.result: 预训练视觉先验并非必要，联合训练编码器可达到接近预训练编码器的效果；但无编码器模型即使扩大主干参数仍落后于视觉理解任务。视觉专用容量不必完全前置到融合前，在融合后早期主干中加入视觉模块可接近前置编码器性能，并可能降低首个词元时间。
AI.conclusion: 多模态语言模型更应重视与主干联合训练的专用视觉容量，并尽早布置在融合位置附近，而非依赖单独的视觉预训练阶段或严格前置的视觉编码器。

title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出PixVid，一种将预训练隐空间视频扩散模型迁移到像素空间直接生成每一帧的方法；它保留DiT，仅将VAE decoder替换为卷积输出头，并通过直接预测干净视频和更大噪声shift来提升质量，从而在高分辨率、条件对齐和交互式响应方面优于传统隐空间生成。
AI.motivation: 主流视频生成模型依赖VAE隐空间，同时对空间和时间进行压缩。这种压缩虽然使训练可行，但在高分辨率、可控生成和交互式应用中带来限制：分辨率翻倍会使token数变为四倍；条件通常施加在多帧块上而非单帧；模型必须等待整个多帧块生成后才能响应动作。因此，作者希望让预训练隐空间模型能够直接在像素空间逐帧生成，以缓解这些限制。
AI.method: PixVid从预训练潜变量视频扩散模型（如Wan2.1-14B）出发，保留原有diffusion transformer主体，但移除VAE decoder，并用一个卷积头将模型输出直接渲染到像素空间。与潜空间中预测速度或噪声相关目标不同，PixVid采用直接预测干净视频的训练目标，并引入更大的噪声shift，使像素空间去噪过程更稳定、质量更高。整体上，它将“潜空间生成后再解码”转变为“像素空间逐帧直接生成”。
AI.result: 实验表明，从Wan2.1-14B微调得到的PixVid在约1.3M训练片段规模下即可与潜空间基线表现相当。由于工作在像素空间并逐帧生成，PixVid能在相同单帧token数下实现2倍更高分辨率生成；在深度引导的视频编辑任务中，即使存在快速运动，条件对齐仍然保持稳定；同时，模型可以针对每个动作在下一帧即时响应，更适合交互式视频生成场景。
AI.conclusion: PixVid证明了一种简单但有效的“潜空间预训练视频模型向像素空间迁移”范式：通过替换解码器为卷积输出头、预测干净视频并调整噪声shift，可以绕开VAE时空压缩带来的分辨率、控制和对齐限制，同时保持与强基线相当的训练效率，为高分辨率、条件可控和交互式视频生成提供了实用路径。

title: Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HDH：一种轻量级框架，利用冻结视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实部署中的“事后经验”训练紧凑动作验证器，为每个动作块预测任务成功分数，并在查询策略时从候选动作中挑选高分者执行，从而以较低延迟提升机器人操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型在通用机器人操作中表现良好，但其采样出的动作序列可能无效；若使用计算昂贵的验证器评估替代动作，会在每次策略查询时增加推理延迟。因此，需要一种轻量、低延迟的方法，在不更新或微调大规模 VLA 的前提下提高动作选择和任务执行成功率。
AI.method: HDH 包含三个阶段：第一，部署冻结的 VLA 策略并收集其自主执行轨迹；第二，基于这些部署数据中的事后任务成功信息，训练一个紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作块预测任务成功分数；第三，在推理时让冻结的 VLA 生成多个动作候选，由验证器根据预测分数选择得分最高的候选执行。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-10 的四个任务上，HDH 平均成功率达到 82.3%；在三个真实世界机器人操作任务上，HDH 相比基线策略平均提升成功率 22.6%。
AI.conclusion: HDH 利用冻结 VLA 自身部署数据中的事后信息进行轻量级动作验证，在不重新训练或显著增加计算开销的情况下，有效改善了候选动作筛选和机器人操作成功率，为低延迟、可扩展的 VLA 部署验证提供了可行方案。

title: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
summary: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at this https URL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EM-ViT，一种面向机器人场景的单目深度估计方法，通过在线适应将基础模型输出的相对深度转换为度量尺度深度，提升在新环境中的泛化能力与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计基础模型可为机器人感知提供密集且长程的深度信息，并替代昂贵的 LiDAR 或双目相机等硬件。然而，这些模型大多基于仿射不变深度表示训练，难以直接确定真实场景的度量尺度，在新环境中的泛化能力也尚不明确，因此需要一种在线尺度恢复与适应方法。
AI.method: 作者提出 EM-ViT，其核心思想是将深度预测分解为两部分：一是通过密集视差细化恢复场景相对结构，二是预测有效基线标量以确定缺失的度量尺度。该方法以立体相机参数化为启发，利用稀疏 LiDAR 点以及可选的机器人自身运动信息，在线训练轻量级 Vision Transformer，并设计内部梯度匹配损失，以在实时适应过程中保留输入视差的细粒度结构和语义信息。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 等公开数据集序列上的实验表明，EM-ViT 的在线学习流程能够比现有单目深度估计基础模型更快适应新场景，并获得更高的深度预测精度。
AI.conclusion: EM-ViT 有效弥补了单目深度基础模型在度量尺度和新场景泛化方面的不足，为机器人低成本、高效且鲁棒的几何感知提供了一种实用的在线学习方案。

title: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
summary: Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks. In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations across multiple vehicle platforms in different locations, we identify ten key challenges that hinder the development of weather-resilient autonomy, including data scarcity, domain shifts, limitations in multimodal perception, control robustness, and validation gaps, among others. We summarize these challenges and lessons learned toward enabling reliable snow-autonomous driving, highlighting critical directions for future research and standardization.

AI.tldr: 该摘要综述了恶劣天气对自动驾驶感知与控制带来的关键挑战，并基于ROADVIEW项目提炼出实现抗雪、抗雨、抗雾等鲁棒自动驾驶的十大问题与研究启示。
AI.motivation: 当前自动驾驶研究多集中于晴朗天气，而雪、雨、雾等恶劣天气仍会导致感知与控制性能显著下降，是实现高可靠性自动驾驶的重要瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者基于欧盟Horizon Europe项目ROADVIEW四年的开发经验与多平台、多地点真实场景验证，系统总结恶劣天气下自动驾驶面临的主要挑战。
AI.result: 提炼出数据稀缺、域偏移、多模态感知局限、控制鲁棒性不足、验证缺口等十类关键挑战，并归纳面向雪天等极端天气可靠自动驾驶的经验教训。
AI.conclusion: 要实现恶劣天气下可靠的自动驾驶，需要未来在数据构建、跨天气感知、控制鲁棒性、测试验证与标准化等方面开展进一步研究。

title: What Makes a VLA Reactive? A Study of Execution Strategies for Dynamic Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, and when objects move, those chunks go stale before they are executed. We study what makes a pretrained VLA reactive, using \pihalf{} on two dynamic simulation benchmarks and three real-robot tasks. We vary the prediction and execution horizons, compare synchronous and asynchronous inference, test methods that deliver actions sooner or keep successive chunks continuous, and adapt the policy with motion cues and latent-space reinforcement learning. The best prediction horizon is about one second, and the best execution horizon depends on the checkpoint. Short horizons help more with asynchronous execution, and methods that keep the trajectory continuous outperform those that only reduce latency. Adapting the policy repairs targeted failures, but on the conveyor task changing the execution horizon gained as much. Reactivity depends on the execution pipeline as much as on the policy, so both should be evaluated together.
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, Efficient Foundation Models for Real-Time Embodied AI, CoRL 2026 Workshop

AI.tldr: 该摘要研究预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在动态环境中的“反应性”问题：模型预测的是未来动作块，当物体持续运动时，这些动作块在执行前可能过时。论文通过改变预测与执行时域、推理同步/异步方式、动作块衔接策略以及策略适配方法，评估 VLA 系统如何更好地对实时变化作出反应。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型通常以“动作块”形式预测未来一段连续动作，这在静态环境中有效，但在物体快速运动或环境持续变化的任务中，早期预测的动作可能变得不准确。因此，需要理解预训练 VLA 模型的反应性来自何处，尤其是推理管线、时域选择和执行机制对反应能力的影响。
AI.method: 论文使用 \pihalf{} 模型，在两个动态仿真基准和三个真实机器人任务上进行实验。实验比较了不同预测时域和执行时域，对比同步推理与异步推理，并测试两类改进方向：一是尽快输出动作以降低延迟，二是保持连续动作块之间轨迹平滑衔接。此外，还通过运动线索和潜空间强化学习对策略进行适配。
AI.result: 结果显示，最佳预测时域约为 1 秒，但最佳执行时域取决于具体检查点。较短执行时域在异步推理下收益更明显。相比仅降低动作输出延迟，保持连续动作块之间轨迹一致性的方法表现更好。策略适配能够修复特定失败模式，但在传送带任务中，调整执行时域带来的收益与适配策略相当。
AI.conclusion: VLA 模型的反应性不仅取决于策略本身，也高度依赖推理与执行管线。因此，评估和提升动态场景中的机器人策略时，应同时考虑预测/执行时域、同步或异步推理、动作块衔接机制以及策略适配方法。

title: Reading the Table: Sim-to-Real Game State Detection for the Chef's Hat Card Game
summary: Tabletop games offer a compelling scenario to study the interaction between artificial and human agents, combining social interaction with game state tracking and physical manipulation. To assess the game state, a robot needs to precisely detect closely related game objects, such as different card designs, requiring dedicated training data that is costly to annotate in the real world. Instead, we develop a fully automated synthetic data collection pipeline, using re-projection of known 3D coordinates to generate labels automatically and domain randomization to bridge the reality gap. This approach is used to collect a dataset of 25413 samples to finetune an object detection and a segmentation model, which are combined to assign detected cards to game-relevant zones and infer the game state. When evaluated on a real NICO humanoid robot, our pipeline achieves an F1-score of 0.906 for card-to-zone assignment, thus providing the perceptual foundation for a robot that can autonomously play Chef's Hat against human players.
comment: Presented at the Dungeons, Neurons, and Dialogues workshop (DnD-SIDC 2026) at ICANN 2026, this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种面向桌面游戏机器人感知的自动化合成数据生成流程，通过3D坐标重投影生成标签并结合域随机化，训练物体检测与分割模型，实现卡牌状态识别并支撑人形机器人自主对战。
AI.motivation: 桌面游戏涉及社交互动、游戏状态追踪和物理操作，是研究人工agent与人类交互的重要场景；但评估游戏状态需要精确识别高度相似的实体（如不同卡面设计），真实世界数据标注成本高，难以规模化获取。
AI.method: 构建全自动化合成数据采集流程：利用已知3D坐标进行重投影，自动生成卡牌检测与分割标签；采用域随机化缩小仿真与真实场景之间的差异；基于生成的25413个样本微调物体检测模型和分割模型；再将检测结果与分割/区域分配结合，把卡牌映射到游戏相关区域并推断游戏状态。
AI.result: 在真实NICO人形机器人平台评估中，卡牌到区域分配任务的F1-score达到0.906，表明该感知方案能够有效支撑机器人自主进行《Chef's Hat》桌面游戏并对抗人类玩家。
AI.conclusion: 自动化合成数据流水线能够以较低成本解决相似游戏物体感知标注难题，为机器人桌面游戏中的状态估计、目标-区域关联和自主游戏决策提供可靠视觉基础。

title: EMS-Nav: Embodied Multi-Scale Navigation
summary: Industrial inspection robots must reach work areas and specific equipment. These destinations span spatial scales from regions to objects, so robots must relate each target to its surroundings to interpret the task and determine where to go. Existing methods support multi-scale navigation through rich environment representations, but at substantial computational and storage cost. These costs limit deployment where wireless coverage is incomplete and robots must rely on onboard computation to keep navigating. We introduce EMS-Nav, a biologically inspired multi-scale navigation framework for online, on-device operation. Its core innovation is to organize perception, spatial understanding, and navigation around regions, making local spaces the basic units of both environmental understanding and computation. EMS-Nav groups objects and their relationships into functionally meaningful spaces and builds a hierarchy from local areas to the broader environment. This organization supports efficient map construction alongside the interpretation and execution of language goals at different scales. In multi-scale navigation experiments, EMS-Nav achieves the highest success rates across all four target categories: objects, rooms, regions, and specific instances. It outperforms state-of-the-art open-vocabulary mapping and navigation methods, improving overall first-attempt success by 9.39 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing mapping overhead and language-model input size. Local deployment in real indoor environments further demonstrates its applicability to on-device embodied navigation. By establishing regions as the organizing basis for perception, spatial understanding, and language-guided action, EMS-Nav provides a system that combines multi-scale understanding with computational efficiency to support diverse language goals on resource-constrained robots.

AI.tldr: EMS-Nav提出一种仿生启发的多尺度在线导航框架，以“区域”作为感知、空间理解和导航的基本组织单元，通过构建从局部空间到整体环境的层次化表示，在资源受限机器人上高效实现面向物体、房间、区域和实例的语言引导导航。
AI.motivation: 工业巡检机器人需要到达工作区域或特定设备，这些目标具有多尺度特性，要求机器人将目标与其周围环境关联起来以理解任务并决定路径。现有方法虽然能通过丰富的环境表示支持多尺度导航，但计算和存储开销较大，难以在无线覆盖不完整、需要依赖机载计算持续导航的场景中部署。
AI.method: 该方法的核心创新是将局部区域作为环境理解和计算的基本单元：将物体及其相互关系组织成功能上有意义的空间，并建立从局部区域到更广泛环境的层次结构。基于这种组织方式，系统能够在线完成地图构建、多尺度空间理解以及对语言目标的解释与执行，从而降低建图开销并减少语言模型的输入规模。
AI.result: 在多尺度导航实验中，EMS-Nav在物体、房间、区域和具体实例四类目标上均取得最高成功率。相比最强基线，其整体首次尝试成功率提升9.39个百分点，同时降低了建图开销和语言模型输入长度。在真实室内环境中的局部部署实验进一步验证了该方法适用于资源受限机器人上的机载具身导航。
AI.conclusion: 以“区域”作为组织感知、空间理解和语言引导行动的基础单元，可以使导航系统同时具备多尺度理解能力和计算效率，从而支持资源受限机器人执行多样化语言目标，适用于工业巡检等实际部署场景。

title: MOSAIC: Modular Obstacle and Spatial-Aware Framework for Manipulation In Cluttered Scenes
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet most rely primarily on 2D visual observations and language instructions, leaving scene geometry and obstacle relationships to be inferred implicitly. This limitation is particularly problematic in cluttered environments, where small spatial errors can lead to unintended contacts or collisions. We propose MOSAIC, a modular spatial- and obstacle-aware framework that can be integrated with pretrained VLA policies to improve object-level scene understanding and action generation. Our method augments the VLA backbone with an auxiliary semantic grounding task that predicts role-specific masks for the target object, destination region, and surrounding obstacles. We further combine the target and destination masks with depth estimated from 3D scene reconstruction to construct role-specific geometric tokens that are injected directly into the action expert. In addition, we propose obstacle-aware attention supervision that emphasizes obstacles near the robot body during task execution. The resulting attention features are subsequently injected into later action-expert layers to further guide action generation. Together, these components provide explicit semantic, geometric, and obstacle-aware cues while preserving the underlying pretrained VLA architecture. We evaluate our framework on pretrained VLA model using the RoboPRO benchmark, including visual perturbation tests, and further validate it on real-world manipulation tasks. MOSAIC improves the success rate by 5.1% in cluttered scenes, and by 9.7% under visual perturbations, with gains of up to 25.0% in the most challenging environment. We will release our code and dataset upon acceptance at the following Github page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MOSAIC 是一种模块化、空间感知与障碍物感知的增强框架，可插入预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中，通过目标/目标区域/障碍物的语义掩码、基于深度的几何 token 和障碍物注意力监督，提升杂乱场景中的机器人操作成功率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型主要依赖二维视觉观测和语言指令，隐含推断三维场景几何与障碍物关系；在杂乱环境中，这种空间理解不足容易导致轻微位置误差引发接触或碰撞，从而降低操作成功率和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出 MOSAIC 框架，与预训练 VLA 主干集成：(1) 引入辅助语义 grounding 任务，分别预测目标物体、目标区域和周围障碍物的角色专属掩码；(2) 将目标与目标区域掩码结合三维场景重建得到的深度信息，构造角色专属几何 token 并注入 action expert；(3) 设计障碍物感知注意力监督，强调靠近机器人本体的障碍物，并将相关注意力特征注入后续 action expert 层，引导动作生成；整体保持原 VLA 架构不被重训破坏。
AI.result: 在预训练 VLA 模型上，基于 RoboPRO benchmark 和视觉扰动测试以及真实世界操作任务验证：MOSAIC 在杂乱场景中提升成功率 5.1%，在视觉扰动下提升 9.7%，在最困难环境中最高提升 25.0%。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC 通过显式补充语义、几何和障碍物感知信息，在不改变预训练 VLA 主干的前提下显著增强机器人操作对空间关系的理解，尤其提升杂乱和扰动场景中的碰撞规避能力与泛化鲁棒性。

title: I See What You Want: Decoding Hierarchical Operator Intent from Visual Teleoperation History
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a powerful foundation for robotic scene understanding, task planning, and language-conditioned control. A natural question follows: can these models also decode what a human operator intends while teleoperating a robot, without any explicit instruction? We formulate this as hierarchical intent prediction, jointly inferring the ongoing atomic action and the broader mission it serves from a short visual teleoperation history. To study this, we introduce VI AMO (Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing), a dataset of 6,600 episodes from eleven robot sources with 13,653 temporally aligned action annotations and 9,702 mission annotations. Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554. Fine-tuning a VLM on VI AMO yields our Vision-Intention Model (VIM), which raises these scores to 0.825 and 0.821 and still reaches 0.726 and 0.717 on the 35.4% of test actions with both labels absent from training. Finally, as a downstream application, VIM's predicted mission enables a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to take over from the operator mid-task in a real-world environment unseen during VIM fine-tuning, reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何仅通过短暂视觉遥操作历史，同时预测人类操作员正在执行的原子动作及其背后的整体任务意图，并提出数据集VIAMO与微调模型VIM，实现比大型闭源VLM更强的层级意图解码与实时接管能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在机器人场景理解、任务规划和语言条件控制中表现强大，但能否在无人工显式指令的情况下推断操作员意图仍不明确。该问题对减少人工遥操作负担、提升机器人自主接管和任务规划能力具有重要意义。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为层级意图预测，联合推理当前原子动作与更高层任务目标。构建VIAMO数据集，包含6,600个来自11个机器人来源的episode、13,653个时间对齐动作标注和9,702个任务标注。随后微调视觉语言模型得到VIM，并以其预测任务引导VLA策略在真实环境中接管操作员任务。
AI.result: GPT-4o和GPT-5.6 Luna在保留episode上的动作和任务Sentence-BERT相似度较低，例如GPT-4o为0.563/0.470。VIM微调后将动作和任务相似度提升至0.825/0.821，并在35.4%测试动作标签未训练可见的情况下仍达到0.726/0.717。下游任务中，VIM预测使VLA策略相比GPT-4o和GPT-5.6 Luna分别减少34.6%和39.8%遥操作时间，意图预测平均延迟降低约70%。
AI.conclusion: 在VIAMO上微调的VIM能够以较高准确率和低延迟解码视觉遥操作中的层级意图，并支持VLA策略在未见真实环境中半自主接管任务，说明面向机器人意图理解的专用VLM训练具有显著潜力。

title: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
summary: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention. This paper presents AgriSense, a framework combining an Isaac Sim virtual greenhouse, a quadruped mobile manipulator, RGB and LiDAR-inertial sensing, environmental control, and supervised vision-language decision support. Frozen DINOv2 and BERT encoders, together with structured environmental inputs, support joint prediction of twelve environmental references, a target zone, and an intervention flag. Checkpoint replay reproduces 41/43 zone decisions. Across five seeds on a source-grouped test set, the full, image-removed, and language-removed configurations each achieve 43/44 correct zone decisions, providing no evidence of incremental multimodal zone-accuracy improvement. The full model achieves mean absolute errors of 0.249 degrees C for temperature, 2.030 percentage points for humidity, and 0.997 percentage points for soil moisture. Sensor-only inputs match full-model zone accuracy, while language-only inputs achieve 68.64%. External real-image benchmarks reveal distribution-shift limitations. Five offline Point-LIO routes yield rigidly aligned trajectory errors of 5.22-17.32 mm. Of 40 virtual-arm targets, 32 satisfy geometric acceptance criteria and eight are rejected at boundaries. Six long-horizon climate cases and fault protocols characterize integration limits. Navigation and integrated treatment rely on simulator-state inputs; physical greenhouse performance and agronomic treatment efficacy remain unvalidated. The contribution is an evaluated decision-support and robotic-intervention framework for a virtual greenhouse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgriSense：一个面向虚拟温室的“感知—环境控制—视觉语言决策—机器人干预”集成框架，但在真实温室和农艺干预效果方面尚未完成验证。
AI.motivation: 自主温室管理需要同时整合感知、导航、环境调控和植株级干预，而现有系统往往缺少统一的机器人决策支持框架和端到端评估。
AI.method: 作者基于Isaac Sim构建虚拟温室，使用四足移动机械臂、RGB相机和LiDAR惯性感知，并结合环境控制模块；模型采用冻结的DINOv2视觉编码器和BERT语言编码器，输入结构化环境信息，联合预测12个环境参考值、目标区域和是否需要干预的标志。随后通过checkpoint replay、五种子的源分组测试集、消融配置、真实图像基准、轨迹回放、虚拟机械臂目标验收和长时程气候/故障协议进行评估。
AI.result: 区域决策复现结果为41/43；完整模型、去除图像模型和去除语言模型在五种子上均达到43/44的区域正确率，未观察到多模态带来额外区域准确率提升。仅传感器输入也能匹配完整模型的区域准确率，而仅语言输入为68.64%。完整模型对环境量预测的绝对误差分别为温度0.249°C、湿度2.030个百分点、土壤湿度0.997个百分点。五组离线Point-LIO轨迹的刚性对齐误差为5.22–17.32 mm。40个虚拟机械臂目标中32个满足几何验收标准，8个在边界处被拒绝。真实图像基准暴露了分布偏移问题。导航和综合处理依赖仿真器状态输入，物理温室表现与农艺干预有效性仍未验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的主要贡献是提出并评估了一个面向虚拟温室的机器人化决策支持与干预框架，证明了系统级集成的可行性；但其性能高度依赖仿真环境状态，且真实部署、鲁棒泛化和实际农艺疗效仍需进一步验证。

title: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
summary: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.

AI.tldr: 提出Flying-on-a-Word（Flow）任务与UAV-Flow数据集，并开发FlowVLA模型，通过模仿预训练和Tail-Aware GRPO后训练实现语言引导的短程、物体相对无人机飞行动作，显著提升闭环成功率与真实场景执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语言引导无人机导航多关注长时程路线规划，缺乏对短程、以物体为中心的复杂飞行动作的系统建模与评估；需要一种能结合自然语言指令、第一人称视觉观测和当前状态动态生成连续飞行动作的任务、数据与学习框架。
AI.method: 作者定义Flow任务，涵盖基础运动指令和物体交互行为，以评估运动意图理解与空间上下文定位；构建UAV-Flow数据集，包含30,692条专家操控的真实世界轨迹、覆盖八类运动，以及10,109条带任务完成判定标准的UAV-Flow-Sim仿真轨迹。提出FlowVLA，先在真实与仿真混合演示上进行模仿预训练，再通过Tail-Aware GRPO（TGRPO）进行在线后训练；TGRPO利用组奖励分布强化高奖励动作序列，以提升策略学习、闭环评估和样本效率。
AI.result: 在273个留出UAV-Flow-Sim episodes上，预训练FlowVLA平均成功率为75.58%，比最强基线高6.72个百分点；经TGRPO后训练成功率进一步提升至93.16%，并表现出更优的样本效率。真实无人机室内和室外实验验证了其对物体相对语言命令的稳健执行能力。
AI.conclusion: Flow为语言条件飞行动作提供了新基准和学习框架；UAV-Flow与FlowVLA证明结合真实-仿真预训练和TGRPO后训练能够显著提升无人机对自然语言指令的短程、物体相对操控能力，为语言引导的低层飞行动作研究提供了有效路径。

title: ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
summary: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ProtoVis-Nav，通过“原型视觉想象”让无人机视觉语言导航模型先预测下一个目标位置的局部视觉表示，再据此生成更准确的航路点与动作。
AI.motivation: 在无人机视觉语言导航中，3D 运动预测的小误差可能导致导航偏差和碰撞，而现有方法难以理解动作在 3D 环境中的执行结果，因此不能从语言指令中稳定预测准确航路点。
AI.method: 提出 ProtoVis-Nav 框架：模型先为预想的下一步无人机移动想象一个与执行结果相关的局部视觉表示；具体通过预测特征原型，并用这些原型的线性组合估计目标区域的视觉特征；随后将预测原型作为上下文指导最终动作/航路点生成，促进视觉上下文与导航输出的一致性。
AI.result: 在大量实验中，ProtoVis-Nav 表现出有效性，并较现有基线方法取得显著提升。摘要未给出具体数据集、指标或数值提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作说明：引入面向动作执行结果的原型式视觉想象，可增强 UAV 视觉语言导航中对目标位置视觉状态的预测能力，从而改善航路点生成的准确性与安全性。
